# Quests of Banshee (Blackspore Swamp)

## Verdict

No quest is evidenced as **given by the Banshee (npc 9500000000)**. The only candidate, "Defeat the cemetery banshee!", is the **main goal of the Bone Bog Cemetery dungeon (normal version)**. It is an instance objective, not an NPC offer. The `quest_giver` role and the `quests_given_text` entry in `blackspore_swamp.json` look like a misreading of the video frame TjpDl22Lwpk/00326, which shows the goal panel. Nothing should be added to `quests/*.json` for this NPC. The dossier below is kept so a builder can see the evidence and decide.

## Candidate: "Defeat the cemetery banshee!" (dungeon main goal, not a giver quest)

- **Title / goal text:** "Defeat the cemetery banshee!"
  - Locale tool id **414879**. The client's raw key is `407646356` (`ucdt`), per `opening-anvil-placement-v1/locale/en_us_data.dat:10786`.
  - The tool's ids and the guides' `loc` numbers use different keys. The record's `name_string_id 3082` ("Banshee") works in the tool, but the guide's raw key for it is `2846974697`. So the tool id 414879 ↔ raw 407646356 mapping is inferred from the same pattern and from the adjacent ids; the text match is exact.
- **Intro / story hook:** "A banshee has moved in or risen from the cemetery and is causing problems. Are you brave enough to enter and chase her away?"
  - Locale tool id **414880**, raw key `3691261868` (`ucdt`, `.dat:97725`).
  - This is the dungeon's entry hook. No NPC offer is attached to it in any source. The hook sits in the dungeon's "Story hook (normal)" row, `notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Bone Bog Cemetery.md:21`.
- **Objective lines:**
  - Main: the goal text above.

n9500000006.quest_dossier:
# Quests of Block Loblog (Blackspore Swamp)

## Summary

Block Loblog gives no quests. He is a dead dwarf whose log is the objective of one quest. The wiki and the guide file that quest under **Vrok/Vrock Gravelfist**, not under Loblog. The record's own `quests_given_text` ("Quest item, not a speaker") agrees. A builder should attach this quest to Vrock Gravelfist (repo `npcs/blackspore_swamp.json`, Vrock entry around line 39450), with Loblog as the place where the item is found. Only one quest is tied to Loblog, so only one dossier follows.

## Quest 1: Block Loblog's Bog Log (unbuilt; no file in `quests/` matches "Loblog", "Bog Log" or the ids)

**Giver (per evidence):** Vrock Gravelfist. The wiki lists it under his Quests (`freerealms-wiki/wikitext/8670-49690-f28dad899b06.wiki` lines 17 and 22). The guide's series table, row 13, lists the giver/hand-in as "Vrock Gravelfist, Iliya" (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Blackspore Swamp.md` line 204). Iliya's wiki page also lists it under Appearances (`freerealms-wiki/wikitext/3318-50399-72d47663d3a3.wiki` line 25). The wiki page for Blackspore Swamp lists it at line 75 (`2135-49970-3d05bdf56b37.wiki`).

**Title:** "Block Loblog's Bog Log"
- Locale tool index 385051 (client string ids: ucdt 574157453; ugdt 3465791599).
- Evidence: `client/locale/en_us_data.dat` lines 15249 and 91810. The locale tool output for 385051 is the same string.

**Prerequisites (R):** Series order puts it after Dwarven Expertise (row 12, Iliya sends the player to Vrock about the large crystal, 1480136506) and after Testing a Theory (row 11). Level: unknown. wiki.title: Cakenstein
wiki.text:
Cakenstein is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Birthday Bash. He is a mutant-like walking cake that appears during the only Birthday Bash and in Treasure War. His main goal is to eat the cakes made for the birthday of Free Realms. Cakenstein was created by a robgoblin chef, Glerga. He is often accompanied by cakelings.

Battle
Open World
During the Birthday Bash, a message will pop up saying  "Cakenstein has risen in <Warpstone>". While Cakenstein is risen, fireworks appear in crates on the pathways of eight locations near Cakenstein. You must fire fireworks at him, but while fighting him, he will run around the area, eating the cakes and getting stronger while doing it.

Cakenstein can also spawn cakelings which bring cake to him. If they succeed, Cakenstein will becomes invincible for a short amount of time.

Once defeated, Cakenstein will melt and drop piles of cakes and a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Birthday Bash reward. If he wins, he will successfully eat birthday cakes and disappear, and he will not drop anything.

Cakenstein Attacks!
Cakenstein appears in Queensfields, located in just outside Sanctuary. This battle requires you to be level 13 or higher to start. Cakenstein is trying to eat more birthday cakes, and you must stop him before he becomes any stronger. During the battle he spawns cakelings which will attack you. He also seems to have a weakness of the Fire Power-Up if you use Fire Power-Up to attack him.

Dialogues

Boss Cake
Cakenstein is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.

Appearances

# Quests of Cakenstein (Blackspore Swamp)

## Summary

The record's quest line, "Event boss; the fireworks fight (2622338937)", is a Birthday Bash fight, not a quest that Cakenstein gives. The quest is **Downing Cakenstein**, given by **Commander Kiggle** in Sanctuary (wiki: "Downing Cakenstein from Commander Kiggle in Sanctuary - continuously repeatable"). Cakenstein is the target. The Blackspore record marks Cakenstein `quest_giver`, which looks wrong. A builder should attach this quest to Kiggle's record, not to Cakenstein.

Two IDs need care:
- **2622338937** is not a text id. `locale` returns "no such id". It appears only as a directory-index hash (`en_us_data.dir`, `2622338937 4214024 303 d`), and no matching text was found. It is not the title; the title is 2760856853 / 3696061630 (below).
- The `locale` tool uses its own numbering (e.g. "428097"). The client string ids are the `en_us_data.dat` ids. Both are given below, with the `locale` key in brackets.

## Quest 1: Downing Cakenstein (unbuilt)

Checked: no match for "Downing" or "Cakenstein" in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json`.

- **Giver:** Commander Kiggle, Royal Guard commander, Sanctuary. Client name string 74507 (`repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/sanctuary.json:14276-14311`, npc_id 9500000465, `quests_given_text` names the Cakenstein fight). Sanctuary location line: "Commander Kiggle in Sanctuary wants you to defeat Cakenstein." (dat 729705476, `locale` 428677). Also `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Sanctuary.md:32`.
- **Title:** "Downing Cakenstein". dat ucdt 3696061630 / ugdt 2760856853 (`locale` 428097). Wiki: `refs:freerealms-wiki/wikitext/7912-44814-fd93476b7f62.wiki:21` and `refs:freerealms-wiki/wikitext/2426-49987-d3dcbf5d9567.wiki:50` ("Quest:Downing Cakenstein")

wiki.title: Cragara
wiki.text:
Cragara, also known as the Mysterious Merchant, is a mysterious NPC merchant that appears at locations at random offering items at random.

Generally Cragara sells items that vary from regular SC Marketplace items with large discount prices, exclusive content that isn't available through the SC Marketplace, and SC Marketplace items at store price but available in rare, exclusive colors.

Cragara is constantly relocating her shop and is not always available in Free Realms. She only offers the opportunity to purchase 4-6 different items at random and in limited quantity at each relocation.

Cragara's Shop Closed

Originally Cragara's shops were closed upon the in-game introduction of late 2012. When activated, Cragara provided dialogue explaining that she was resting after a long journey from Black Forest, an area that is located east of Stillwater Crossing.

Locations
Cragara spawns in the six following locations: Seaside, Merry Vale, Snowhill, Blackspore Swamp, Briarwood, and Sunstone Valley.

Items Cragara sells

 

 

Gallery

Trivia
Cragara is currently the only known snail in Free Realms.
However there is a snail guard in one of Free Realms roster arts we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Cragara's kind.

**Scope.** No quest in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json` names Donovan or any of his six titles, so all six are unbuilt. The record and the guide (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Blackspore Swamp.md`, Part A row 28 and series table rows 1–6, lines 192–197) list them. I built the four with the clearest Donovan-side text: Darci's Deficiencies, Favors for Favors, The Mining Operation and Combating the Cray.

**Id note.** The `locale` tool uses its own sequential string ids (for example 78765). The hash-style ids in the guide (for example 1000915545) do not resolve there. Where the raw `en_us_data.dat` grep found a hash id, I cite it as `refs:opening-mining-native-20261009T121330Z/locale/en_us_data.dat:<line>`.

---

## 1. Darci's Deficiencies

- **Title:** locale 78765 "Darci's Deficiencies". Dat hash 1000915545 (ugdt), refs dat line 26535.
- **Giver:** Donovan Shadeweaver (36332792). Hand-in is Donovan, with Darci Flitterstride (name 1086712442) as the field target.
- **Offer, Donovan (locale 78764):** "I hired a scout, Darci Flitterstride. Her work has been, how shall I put it... less than impressive. Want her job? Find Darci and tell her I've hired you as her assistant. I hope for your sake you prove more capable."
- **Quest description (locale 78766):** "Donovan hired Darci Flitterstride to help scout better settlement locations in Blackspore since Mire's Edge is slowly sinking into the swamp. She hasn't lived up to his expectations."
- **Steps:**
  1. Find Darci at her camp in Mire's Edge and become her assistant. Objective: locale 78779 "Assist Darci Flitterstride in Mire's Edge to make sure her job gets done."

wiki.text:
Eggert the Mad is a changeling NPC that can be found in a tent north of the Blackspore warpstone. He is a local alchemist that specializes in poisons. Eggert employed a human named Milford as an apprentice to assist in collecting ingredients for his potions found throughout Blackspore swamps.

Eggert offers a quest to seek out his apprentice, Milford, who Eggert sent out on an errant run. After Milford is located, the player is offered a full quest series to assist locating ingredients for Eggert. The ingredients include poisonous toads, bogwarts, strangleroot and more.

# Quests of Ethan's sister Bella, Greyli Dustywings (None)

# Bella (Ethan's sister), npc 9500000023: quests she gives

**Bottom line.** The only source that ties Bella to these quests is one `[client]` row in the Blackspore guide (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Blackspore Swamp.md:182`: "Spectral Spectacles and Ethan's candy bag; see NPCs - Sanctuary"). The Sanctuary guide does not repeat it. It lists Bella only for the spare-robe errand (`NPCs - Sanctuary.md:180`). No offer text in the client binds Bella as giver of either quest. The Spectral Spectacles quest is offered by **Greyli Dustywings** (9500000488), not Bella. Bella's only evidenced role is in the Ethan's-candy-bag chain, as a turn-in and quest-talk NPC. I found no quest record in `quests/*.json` for either quest, so both are unbuilt. The locale string ids below come from the `locale` tool. # Quests of Ghostshadow, Wildclaw, Magetech and Crackshot (Blackspore Swamp)

## Ghostshadow, Wildclaw, Magetech and Crackshot (npc_id 9500000030)

**Result: no quests to build for this character.** The four Realmkeepers give no quests of their own. Their only quest-related role is as the captives freed inside Madam Zelda's Card Duelist chain.

### Evidence
- Record: `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/blackspore_swamp.json:13347-13376`. `quests_given`, `quest_ids_given` and `quests_accepted` are all empty. `quests_given_text` reads "Appear in Zelda's chain (Card Duelist); no quests of their own". The `roles: quest_giver` tag is not backed by any quest.
- Guide: `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Blackspore Swamp.md:120` gives the same verdict ("Appear in Zelda's chain ([[Card Duelist]]); no quests of their own").
- Names resolve to ucdt/ugdt client ids: Crackshot 272627330, Magetech 3557057741 (ucdt, per the guide), Wildclaw 762823596 (locale: "Wildclaw"), Ghostshadow 2672612943 (per the guide). These are hero/captive names, not quest offers.

Madam Zelda is a human NPC that can be found in Blackspore Swamp where she hosts special quests during the Super Spooktacular. She also assisted in the TCG Series 4 (Baron von Darkcheat) by gathering all of the Realmkeepers together and training them to defeat the series namesake, Baron von Darkcheat.

# Quests of Milford (Blackspore Swamp) # Milford (npc 9500000047, Blackspore Swamp): unbuilt quest dossier Milford is Eggert's apprentice. None of his quests are in `quests/*.json` yet. `adventurer.json` has Eggert's own "Chapter 1" quests (3000049 = title 90957, "The Alchemy of Betrayal"). Those are not Milford's and are not covered here. Locale numbers below are the `locale` tool ids. The 10-digit keys in the record and in `opening-journal-text-v2/locale/en_us_data.dat` are hash keys for the same strings. Quest ids are not evidenced anywhere, so none are given. Use a (R) batch key. Four quests are written up, in this order: Idle Hands, Follow Your Nose, Pulling Weeds, Grave Blossoms. Ordering between the three ingredient quests is inferred, not evidenced. --- ## 1. Idle Hands (find Milford) - **Title:** 90731 "Idle Hands" (dat key 2057409462). - **Giver:** Eggert's intro (90730) sends the player to find Milford. The NPC record lists Idle Hands among Milford's quests (`npcs/blackspore_swamp.json:22047-22049`). Eggert's own record also lists it (`npcs/blackspore_swamp.json:9929`). - **Intro (90730):** "My pupil dances in the swamp... Milford, is his name I think. Find him, and have him return to me with his wonderful gifts.

Search Blackspore Swamp for Milford. Objective 90745 "Search for Milford in Blackspore Swamp." (key 1641429655). 2. Talk to Milford. Objective 90746 "Talk to Milford" (key 4293802580). 3. wiki.title: Pumpkin Prince
wiki.text:
The Pumpkin Prince is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Super Spooktacular. He is the pumpkin monster, his main goal while arrived is to terrorizing the four locations, though his goal was said to rule all of Sacred Grove.

Battle
Open World
During the Super Spooktacular, a message will pop up saying "The Pumpkin Prince is terrorizing in <Warpstone>". While the Pumpkin Prince is arrived, ectoplasmic destabilizer dispseners appear on the pathways of four locations which you will find somewhere near where the Pumpkin Prince is (he is walking around somewhere in that area and anyone can attack him). All you must do is keep firing at him with your ectoplasmic shooter which will be at the bottom of your screen where your combat moves are.

The Pumpkin Prince can spawn undead enemies such as grave elementals or necrowart zombies that will attack you with effects that slow you down. The Pumpkin Prince can also attack you with himself and if he strikes you will be turned into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter ability. You will have to pick up another one when the effect wears off.

Once defeated, he will cry a call in defeat and drop a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Super Spooktacular reward. If he wins he will cry a call of victory and will not drop anything.

Bone Bog Cemetery
The Pumpkin Prince appears in the Bone Bog Cemetery, located in Blackspore Swamp during the Super Spooktacular, which at one point will require you to encounter him in a battle which requires you to be level 13 combat job or above to enter. You going to the dungeon with Lucinda. You will go to fight against the Pumpkin Prince, and send his undead army back to the ghost world. The Pumpkin Prince also spawn the ghosts which will heal him in a battle

# Quests of Pumpkin Prince (Blackspore Swamp)

## Pumpkin Prince (npc_id 9500000057, name string 942570469): no quests to build

**Verdict:** this NPC gives no quests. Nothing in the record qualifies for a dossier.

### Why
- **The record's own text is a boss line, not a quest.** `quests_given_text` reads "Boss only: 'You will not send me back!' (video 0LoQe5VZ0PY/00052)". The locale string is id 415098, "You will not send me back!", and it is a battle line. The zone file agrees: `quests_given: []`, `quest_ids_given: []`, and `quests_accepted_reason` says no hand-in to him was isolated (`prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/blackspore_swamp.json:27052-27058`).
- **The `quest_giver` role looks wrong.** The role tag is carried from the guide row, not from any offer text. The guide's Part F row for him says "Quests they give: Boss only" (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Blackspore Swamp.md:118`).
- **The wiki page has no quest content.** A search of the cached wiki page "Pumpkin Prince" (`refs: freerealms-wiki/raw/d521996b...json`) for "quest" returns nothing.
- **The Sanctuary reference is a dance-off host, not a giver.** The Sanctuary script uses the Pumpkin Prince (NPC id 40001) only to announce the Vampires vs Werewolves dance-off (`refs: Sanctuary-main-20261019/src/Scripts/Zone/HalloweenDanceOff.lua:13, 37-38`). It has no quest data.
- **The boss fight is not a quest.** Its objective, locale 202086571 "Defeat the Pumpkin Prince", belongs to the Bone Bog Cemetery event goal. The Bone Bog dungeon file already records it (`prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/dungeons/bone_bog_cemetery.json`). # Quests of Shadowtalon Initiate, Pupil, Guard, Enforcer, Apprentice (Blackspore Swamp)

## Result: no quests to build for npc 9500000062

**Verdict:** The record is a grouped enemy-kind entry, not a quest giver. No quest is evidenced as given by this NPC, so there is nothing to build from it.

### Why the quest_giver role is not supported

- **The role is an artifact of the grouping.** The record's own `quests_given_text` reads "Enemy kinds only...". The zone guide row says the same: `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Blackspore Swamp.md:141` lists "Shadowtalon Initiate, Pupil, Guard, Enforcer, Apprentice" with Quests column "Enemy kinds only" and Notes "None". The zone JSON carries the same text (`prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/blackspore_swamp.json:30402-30406`, `quests_given: []`, `quest_ids_given: []`, `services: []`, `vendor_stock: null`).
- **The enemy-kind audit agrees.** `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/enemies_unresolved.json:14841-14861` marks this id as "descriptive enemy_kind prose, not a hostile AddNpc actor", status unresolved, and lists the names as "Shadowtalon Initiate / Pupil / Guard / Enforcer / Apprentice". This is a lead about enemies, not a giver.
- **The only wiki text is flavor, not a quest.** `freerealms-wiki/wikitext/6726-50151-8a3eb3c64f76.wiki:5` (Shadowtalon Dojo page): a guard "repeatedly tells [three humans] they are too old to train at the dojo", and threatens to spray them with a hose. No offer, objective, reward or quest name is attached. The client text behind it is `locale 3283869898` ("Look, I don't know who told you to come here, but you're too old to train here."), which is also dialogue, not a quest line.
- **The locale strings that mention Shadowtalon are not offers from this NPC.** Checked: "Shadowtalon Initiate"

Luau

Pet Party
Referees host Pet Parties several times a month in a variety of locations, during these parties, Tiger will offer the Party for Pets quest to players.

- **Title:** not evidenced. The record's only quest text is the sentence below, so it is used here as a working label, not a confirmed title.

  - Evidence: `client/locale/en_us_data.dat:71065` (the locale tool's `locale` lookup on the id returned no match; the id is only found via the raw dat dump and the `.dir` index at `en_us_data.dir:71020`). wiki.title: Cragara
wiki.text:
Cragara, also known as the Mysterious Merchant, is a mysterious NPC merchant that appears at locations at random offering items at random.

Generally Cragara sells items that vary from regular SC Marketplace items with large discount prices, exclusive content that isn't available through the SC Marketplace, and SC Marketplace items at store price but available in rare, exclusive colors.

Cragara is constantly relocating her shop and is not always available in Free Realms. She only offers the opportunity to purchase 4-6 different items at random and in limited quantity at each relocation.

Cragara's Shop Closed

Originally Cragara's shops were closed upon the in-game introduction of late 2012. When activated, Cragara provided dialogue explaining that she was resting after a long journey from Black Forest, an area that is located east of Stillwater Crossing.

Locations
Cragara spawns in the six following locations: Seaside, Merry Vale, Snowhill, Blackspore Swamp, Briarwood, and Sunstone Valley.

Items Cragara sells

 

 

Gallery

Trivia
Cragara is currently the only known snail in Free Realms.
However there is a snail guard in one of Free Realms roster arts we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Cragara's kind.

wiki.title: Darkthorne
wiki.text:
Darkthorne (known as Princess Lavender) is the queen of Briarwood, and the sister of Queen Valerian.

She began ruling over Briarwood after the assassination of her parents, Geoffrey, Valerian's loyal and most trusted advisor, blamed Lavender and the Chugawugs and they were exiled. She stole half the Heartseed from the Royal Palace and took it to Briarheart, where Lavender tore the Heartseed apart and grew a new version of the World Tree and named it Briarheart Palace. She then assumed the name of Darkthorne, Ayani's twin sister.

In the Free Realms comic series, it is explained how Darkthorne was blamed by Geoffrey for poisoning her sister Queen Valerian. We learn that this is false, and at the end of the issue 6, it is explained how Geoffrey had poisoned Queen Valerian. It cames out to a happy ending where Darkthorne and the two protagonists, Dane, and Maya get an antidote to Queen Valerian and save her. Darkthorne disappears seconds before Queen Valerian wakes up.

## Finchel (npc 9500000132, Briarwood, name ucdt 502047733): 1 unbuilt quest

No quest file in `quests/*.json` names Finchel, locale 644265202, or the escort strings. The record's "Title unknown" is out of date: the client has a title string for this quest. Only one quest is evidenced for this NPC.

- **Objective line:** `2569477265`: "Escort Finchel and his dog Spoon out of the Hedge Maze towards the Wilds"

# Quests of Geomancer Hailstorm (Briarwood)

## Result: no quest is evidenced as given by Geomancer Hailstorm (npc 9500000136)

The record's only "quest" line, `quests_given_text` = "Defeat him to free the changelings (client 98909869). Also a campaign boss.", does not describe an offered quest. Every source I checked treats Hailstorm as a dungeon boss and points to the other NPCs who give the quests that mention him. So there is no quest to build from this record, and I did not build a dossier.

### What id 98909869 is

- It is a **dungeon panel description**, not a quest offer. Text: "Geomancer Hailstorm is ruling his changelings through fear! Defeat Hailstorm to free the changelings!"
  - Evidence: `FreeRealmsLocaleTools/test/FreeRealmsLocaleTools.Tests/data/en_us_data.dat:2564` (id 98909869, ucdt). The `locale` tool returns "no such id" for 98909869, so this file is the only place I could confirm the id.
  - `notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Briarheart Caverns.md:16` files it as the panel description, with the same wording.
- The matching goal is "Defeat Geomancer Hailstorm!" (locale id 697034942; `en_us_data.dat:18349`; `briarheart_caverns.md:38`). It is the main goal of the Briarheart Caverns instance.
- The record's "Also a campaign boss" rests on locale 1858376680: "Travel deep into Briarheart Caverns and face off against Geomancer Hailstorm! Earn the Clockwork Cowboy Boots when you complete this campaign. Make sure you have already completed 'Campaign 2: Haunted Mines'." The Briarheart guide (lines 30 and 114) says this is most likely a Treasure War card-campaign blurb, not a quest from Hailstorm. It is unproven and is not an offer.

# Quests of Gloompetal (Briarwood)

## Dossier: Gloompetal (npc_id 9500000139, name_string_id 16610), Briarwood

Quest givers' record: `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/briarwood.json:28401-28435`. Quests given: "Change of Heart" only. It is **not built**: a search of `repo` `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/` for 16611, 16612, 4043878853, "Change of Heart" and "Gloompetal" found nothing. The wiki also lists Gloompetal as a quest giver.

Only one quest, so one section.

### Change of Heart

**Title:** locale **16611** "Change of Heart". (The guide's parenthesised id 4043878853 is the ucdt hash key from the `.dat` file, not a locale-tool id. Locale-tool lookups of hash keys return "no such id".)

**Giver:** Gloompetal, locale 16610 "Gloompetal" (the NPC name). Record: `briarwood.json:28404-28406`. Legacy NPC row: `FreeRealms-Legacy/src/Resources/Npcs.json:9655-9659` (Id 2854, NameId 16610, changeling_f.adr). Spawn: `FreeRealms-Legacy/src/Scripts/Zone/FabledRealms.lua:1597` (`spawnNpcWithGuid(2854, 100000002854, -164.3589, -79.47127, 2605.546, ...)`). Wiki: `refs:freerealms-wiki/wikitext/18598-49950-fea2a85b0fa9.wiki:10,13,16` says she is "found in the tunnel between the Tanglewood Fort and the Briarheart Palace", with "Quest:Change of Heart".

**Prerequisites:** level, job and earlier quest are all **unknown**. Nothing evidenced.

**Intro / offer text:** locale **16612**:
> "Gloompetal wants the changelings to try to integrate themselves into the world and stop being so afraid. See if you can convince the changelings to leave Briarheart Caverns."

Same text in the `.dat` as ucdt 3423625305 (`refs:opening-mining-starter-20261009T180011Z/locale/en_us_data.dat:90572`).

Morgan (npc_id 9500000182, name ucdt 1116075745, Briarwood) gives no quest that I can evidence. His `quests_given_text` value "Targets." is a role note, not an offer. ## Quest 1: The Broken Mirror (pre-release title; quest id not evidenced)

Ids are the `ucdt` keys from `refs:opening-anvil-placement-v1/locale/en_us_data.dat` (line numbers given). The `locale` tool did not accept these keys ("no such id"), so text was copied from that file. Its own numeric ids (e.g. 9832) are a different index. Quest titles were not found in the client for A, B or D. **Already built, skipped:** Chapter 1: The Weapon Shipment (E9, title ucdt 2603070786, in `quests/adventurer.json` ~line 2951). Chapter 1: It's Business Time (E13, title ucdt 1908825225, built ~line 3163). Its intro is Amaranthus, 575707451, which is Cargug's line. The taste-tester escort (275365818) is a step in the Nomnomalug/Darkthorne chain. It is already covered in `npcs/wugachug.json` ~line 11243, and Cargug only relays "safe passage" there, so it is not listed as his quest. --- ## A. Enter Treeleaf's Retreat and put a stop to him!" (en_us_data.dat:87493). Evidence: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Treeleaf's Retreat.md` lines 85-87. - **Companion offer line:** `3158050844` "There is a rather large and nasty-tempered tree-fellow that has set up residence within the Hedge Maze in an area called Treeleaf's Retreat. wiki.text:
Vicki is a human NPC that can be found in Bristlewood, located in Briarwood. She is found in multiple areas depending on what part of the Archer Job quest series you are on.

Vicki is initially found at Farnum's Farm. Later in the series, she can be found directly north of the Bristlewood Warpstone, hiding in front of a large thorny tree root (she would be easily visible from the warpstone, but a huge mushroom is in the way). Her accomplice stands to her left.

## Zargoomi (npc_id 9500000241, name_string_id 3173545253)

**Verdict: no quest is evidenced as given by Zargoomi.** Every source places her as the recipient of a delivery in a quest that Corflugg gives. Her record's `roles: quest_giver` and `quests_given_text` come from the guide row, not from a quote where she offers anything. Nothing was built, so there is no dossier to write for her. The Zargoomi-facing lines belong in Corflugg's chain.

### What the evidence shows

**Quest "There's a shiny stone hidden in the Briar Patch" (client 582349080).** This is the quest the guide attributes to Corflugg (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Briarwood.md:79`; `notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Briar Patch.md:92`).

I can't think of a better way to get Zargoomi's attention. I'm a lover not a Brawler, so maybe you could go retrieve it and deliver it to Zargoomi?"

# Quests of Aunt Daisy (Cobblestone Village)

## Quest dossier: Aunt Daisy (npc_id 9500000244, Cobblestone Village record)

**Correction to the record first.** The quest is listed under Aunt Daisy, but the offer comes from **Ronnie Britesmile** (Merry Vale, name ucdt 1943692833). Daisy is the first objective target, and she sends the player back with a second package. The Lxzxrus community server agrees: its quest has `GiverGuid` and `TargetGuid` 100000002195, which is Ronnie (NPC id 2195). Treat Daisy as a hand-in/objective NPC, not the giver. Ronnie's own record (`npcs/merry_vale.json` ~line 25751) lists this package errand, so the quest should be filed under Ronnie with Daisy as a step.

The record's second id, 832424182, is not a separate quest. It is the return-leg objective of the same quest.

### A Delivery to Aunt Daisy (community quest id 3073; unbuilt)

- **Title:** locale 41861 "A Delivery to Aunt Daisy" (ucdt 2890001209 / ugdt 2348889799, `NPCs - Farnum Farmstead.md` row 166).
- **Giver:** Ronnie Britesmile, Merry Vale. Offer dialogue is locale 41860: "Oh man! I really want to go see the fairy show, but my mom just asked me to deliver this package to my Aunt Daisy at Farnum Farmstead. Say, would you be willing to take it to her? I'd owe you a million!"
- **Intro (description):** locale 41862: "Ronnie has asked you to make a delivery to his Aunt Daisy at Farnum Farmstead. He is supposed to be bringing her a package from his mother, but he'd rather go see the fairy show." (client hash 1094445753 matches this text.)
- **Objective summary:** locale 41866: "Ronnie has asked you to deliver a package to his Aunt Daisy at Farnum Farmstead so he can see the fairy show."

**Steps, in order**
1. **Accept from Ronnie Britesmile** (Merry Vale). Offer = 41860, intro = 418

# Quests of Jonelle (Cobblestone Village)

## Jonelle (npc 9000000120): unbuilt quests

**Already built, skipped:** Chef: Package Recovery! (3050008) and Chef: Queensfields (3050009) are in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/chef.json` (ids at lines 419 and 471). The NPC record and `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Cobblestone Village.md:126-129` agree.

Two unbuilt Jonelle quests have locale text. The guide's hash ids (3770658307, 4102638192, 2385826955, 2265639688, 3753501674, 1574399668) do not resolve in the `locale` tool, which only takes Global.Text ids. I matched them to the texts below by wording only.

---

### 1. Spreading the Cheer (quest id 2587, Postman, care-package delivery)

- **Title:** "Spreading the Cheer": locale 5101187 (repeated at 5101190).
- **Quest id:** 2587. `notes/Research/original-quest-coverage.json:1205-1217` gives it as a region-1 community-journal sticker (sticker_id 6), `title_locale_id` 5101187, `description_locale_id` 5101188, `implementation_state: not-implemented`, with no objectives or rewards recovered. Also `:2884-2888` and `notes/Research/Original Quest Coverage.md:57,114`.
- **Giver:** Jonelle. Evidence is the NPC record's `quests_given_text` (2385826955), and the 5101188 text "As a Postman help Jonelle deliver care packages…", which names her as the person to help. The offer text itself does not name her.
- **Intro (offer), locale 5101186:** "Ever since you freed Cobblestone Village the care packages have been flowing in like crazy. As an authorized Postman would you like to help hand out the care packages?"
- **Journal / objective, locale 5101188:** "As a Postman help Jonelle deliver care packages to the people of Cobblestone Village."
- **Other objective and progress lines:**
  - 5101192: "Deliver all packages"

wiki.title: Vicki
wiki.text:
Vicki is a human NPC that can be found in Bristlewood, located in Briarwood. She is found in multiple areas depending on what part of the Archer Job quest series you are on.

Vicki is initially found at Farnum's Farm. Later in the series, she can be found directly north of the Bristlewood Warpstone, hiding in front of a large thorny tree root (she would be easily visible from the warpstone, but a huge mushroom is in the way). Her accomplice stands to her left.

Category:Females
Category:Human
Category:Bristlewood

# Quests of Bigfoot (Greenwood Forest)

## Bigfoot (npc 9500000287, name loc 428930): no quests given

No quest has evidence of being given by Bigfoot, so there is no dossier to build for this NPC. The NPC record's `quest_giver` role tag contradicts its own text (`quests_given_text`: "None", `quest_ids_given: []`, `title_or_role`: "Not a quest giver").

### Evidence that Bigfoot gives nothing
- `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/greenwood_forest.json` (the record): "Not a quest giver", "None. Target of ...".
- `repo:notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Greenwood Forest.md:51`: Bigfoot row says "Not a quest giver"; the node is clickable only while a Bigfoot quest is held.
- `repo:notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Bigfoot's Lair.md:33, 88-93`: the quests that involve Bigfoot are given by other NPCs (Edmond, Robbie, Jacen). Bigfoot is the battle target.
- `repo:notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Bigfoot Defender.md:79`: Bigfoot's Endangered giver is "not stated; likely Jacen".
- `refs` wiki cache: no Bigfoot NPC page. Bigfoot hits are only the Bigfoot's Lair and Bigfoot Defender battle pages (`freerealms-wiki/wikitext-newline-correction.json`), which name no giver. The wiki-derived notes above are the only quest source.

### Bigfoot-related quests, with the NPCs who actually give them (not built; not Bigfoot's to dossier)
These are listed only so a builder can file them under the right giver. Each is recorded in the Greenwood notes; none is evidenced as coming from Bigfoot.

Chatty is a treeble NPC that can be found at Camp Chatty, located in the Greenwood Forest. Chatty, along with Robbie, are the official mascots of Free Realms.

Gallery
View the gallery: Here

Trivia
Chatty was introduced in-game as a part of Camp Chatty on June 4th, 2010.
Chatty is currently the only known treeble that appears as an NPC in Sacred Grove.
Although there are two treeble pets in-game; Treeble and Striped Treeble we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Chatty's kind.

wiki.text:
Jason Maskface is a human NPC that occasionally comes out on Friday the 13ths. When spawned, he roams the Greenwood Forest around the camps looking to recruit players to scare other players. Players that agree to join in will turn into a banshee, a grave elemental or a skeleton. They will also be given a "Scaredy Cat" ability which grants the power to turn other players into black cats.

# Quests of Jojo (Greenwood Forest)

# Jojo (npc 9500000312, Greenwood Forest, Summer Camp): unbuilt quest dossier

**Scope.** Jojo's ninja-book chain is Wilds South chapter 3. None of the five quests is in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json`. The grep for Jojo and the title hashes there only hits an unrelated Pet Trainer quest, whose title id merely contains "3287". I wrote up the first four, in chain order. Dojo Mojo (dev 3-5) is the fifth and is not written up; its locale strings are listed under Gaps.

**Key finding on the record.** The five hashes in `quests_given_text` (2494369850, 1518704907, 3640780368, 2858199764, 3409500121) are the *dev-label* keys ("SGRevamp - Wilds South - 3-N - ..."), not the player-facing titles. The player-facing title keys are listed per quest below. Both sets are in the client table.

**Evidence sources used throughout:**
- Locale string ids (the `locale` tool), e.g. 441710.
- Locale hash keys from the client table test copy, `refs: FreeRealmsLocaleTools/test/FreeRealmsLocaleTools.Tests/data/en_us_data.dat`, at the line numbers given.
- Guide rows: `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Greenwood Forest.md` lines 186-190 and 198.
- `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Ninja.md:245`.
- `notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Danger Peaks.md:87`.

**Chain inference (applies to all four).** The client has no quest table. The chain order comes from the dialogue ids. Each quest's completion line sits at id N+1 of its title, and the next quest's offer line sits at N+3. Example: 441712 is the A-go-go reaction and 441713 opens Mojo, in Jojo's first-person voice. wiki.title: Robbie
wiki.text:
Robbie is a robgoblin NPC that can be found at Camp Robbie, located in the Greenwood Forest. Robbie, along with Chatty, are the official mascots of Free Realms.

Robbie is also an NPC boss in Bigfoot's Lair, he used to wear the Bigfoot costume which come to attack the player in the battle.

Quests

Quest:Bigfooted Friend

## Result: no quest is given by Bowawow (9500000328)

Bowawow has no evidenced quest of his own. The one client line that names him is a pick-up objective inside a quest that is already built under another giver. I did not write a new quest dossier.

- **Locale 91473**: "Pick up a gift from Bowawow at Highroad Junction". The record's id 2576876953 is the `ucdt` hash key and is not a locale id. The `locale` tool returns "no such id" for it. # Quests of Bugawug Queen (Highroad Junction)

## Dossier: quests given by the Bugawug Queen (npc_id 9500000329, Highroad Junction record)

Only one candidate quest. Its title is now recovered (the record says "title unknown"). It is not built: no `Bugawug` hit under `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/`.

Caveat up front: the evidence shows the quest's **text and target**, not who **gives** it. The NPC record's "quest_giver" role comes from a guide row that only lists the objective. The Wugachug guide marks the giver as "Not stated" (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Wugachug.md:146`), and its Heroes-chain notes say who gives this quest is "unknown" (`:215`).

### 1. The Bugawug Queen

**Title:** "The Bugawug Queen": locale id **442707** (tool index). Client key **2951834333** (ucdt), `locale/en_us_data.dat` line 77912.

**Number convention:** the locale tool's numeric ids are its own row index. The guides and the record cite the client's ucdt hash keys. Both are given below. Example: tool 442688 is the text under key 1844096292.

**Offer / intro text (candidate):**
- Locale **442687** (key 4226350966, `en_us_data.dat` line 111642): "The additional strangeness in Wugachug has been revealed to originate from the newest resident - The Bugawug Queen. Who she is or what she wants has yet to be seen."

Hewey is the boss of the Bear Cave instance (Hewey's Escape). He is not a quest giver in any source I could read. His record's only given quest, "Brawler: Hewey's Escape!", is already built, so there is nothing new to add for him.

The built record's giver is therefore unresolved, and the true giver is Assistant Archy (client text 973814746, 1605633744; `aveqYa4AVk8/00000`) or Harold (wiki). - **Steps:** talk to Archy (300747673) → enter the Bear Cave gate → knock out Hewey → return to Harold's wagon.

wiki.title: Raven
wiki.text:
Raven is a harpy NPC boss featured as the primary antagonist in the Hero Rises questline. Disguised as the Bixie Queen, she attempted to take over Wugachug using gloamwater sarsaparilla. When inside the party tent, at the end of the Chug-a-Mug Challenge battle, she will appear outside the tent to tells the contestants to stop fighting. After the player come to fight Raven in Highroad Junction, she fails and got defeated by the player.

Battle
In the old tutorial area, in Highroad Junction as a world boss. When Raven is there, massive logs will appear and she will fly between them. To get up, you must find some green tornadoes and jump where they are. This will rocket you up and you can land on them. The teleport is quite frequent so be fast. Once defeated, Raven drops Raven's Treasure Chest, bixies will appear and the logs will not be there.

Gallery

Trivia
Raven was introduced in the update of August 13th, 2013.
Raven is currently the only known harpy in Sacred Grove, although Chugzy mentions that harpies are from Lavender Coast, thus implying that there are more of her kind.
Two world bosses, Raven and Nekark were supposed to have Level 20 Awakened fights similar to Necronomicus, but they were never completed before the game shut down.

wiki.title: Cakenstein
wiki.text:
Cakenstein is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Birthday Bash. He is a mutant-like walking cake that appears during the only Birthday Bash and in Treasure War. His main goal is to eat the cakes made for the birthday of Free Realms. Cakenstein was created by a robgoblin chef, Glerga. He is often accompanied by cakelings.

Battle
Open World
During the Birthday Bash, a message will pop up saying  "Cakenstein has risen in <Warpstone>". While Cakenstein is risen, fireworks appear in crates on the pathways of eight locations near Cakenstein. You must fire fireworks at him, but while fighting him, he will run around the area, eating the cakes and getting stronger while doing it.

Cakenstein can also spawn cakelings which bring cake to him. If they succeed, Cakenstein will becomes invincible for a short amount of time.

Once defeated, Cakenstein will melt and drop piles of cakes and a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Birthday Bash reward. If he wins, he will successfully eat birthday cakes and disappear, and he will not drop anything.

Cakenstein Attacks!
Cakenstein appears in Queensfields, located in just outside Sanctuary. This battle requires you to be level 13 or higher to start. Cakenstein is trying to eat more birthday cakes, and you must stop him before he becomes any stronger. During the battle he spawns cakelings which will attack you. He also seems to have a weakness of the Fire Power-Up if you use Fire Power-Up to attack him.

Dialogues

Boss Cake
Cakenstein is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.

Appearances

wiki.title: Cragara
wiki.text:
Cragara, also known as the Mysterious Merchant, is a mysterious NPC merchant that appears at locations at random offering items at random.

Generally Cragara sells items that vary from regular SC Marketplace items with large discount prices, exclusive content that isn't available through the SC Marketplace, and SC Marketplace items at store price but available in rare, exclusive colors.

Cragara is constantly relocating her shop and is not always available in Free Realms. She only offers the opportunity to purchase 4-6 different items at random and in limited quantity at each relocation.

Cragara's Shop Closed

Originally Cragara's shops were closed upon the in-game introduction of late 2012. When activated, Cragara provided dialogue explaining that she was resting after a long journey from Black Forest, an area that is located east of Stillwater Crossing.

Locations
Cragara spawns in the six following locations: Seaside, Merry Vale, Snowhill, Blackspore Swamp, Briarwood, and Sunstone Valley.

Items Cragara sells

 

 

Gallery

Trivia
Cragara is currently the only known snail in Free Realms.
However there is a snail guard in one of Free Realms roster arts we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Cragara's kind.

Only one quest is given by Fenwink itself: **Truffle Shuffle**. The other items in the record's `quests_given_text` belong to other givers, so I did not build them:

## Florit (npc 9500000386, Merry Vale): no quest of his own is evidenced

Florit gives no quest that can be built from the evidence. He appears only as a stop in another quest's tour, and that quest belongs to Mayor McFairy. Nothing in `quests/*.json` or in the wiki cache names Florit as a giver.

The record's `quests_given_text` for Kendra (npc 9500000397) quotes two strings: "Test on Kendra" (3228593347) and "Spray Kendra with the latest version of the love potion" (3523256202). Both are **objective lines** of one quest. The quest is **Potion Testing: Version 7.0**, given by **Cudip**, and Kendra is one of its test targets. Evidence:

I grepped for "Ambassador", "Luella" and "cotton" and found no built quest. I built three legs, Snowhill first because it is the best evidenced. Briarwood and Pixie Nursery follow. The "NOT LIVE" twins (Sanctuary, Seaside, Racetrack, and the cut Snowhill/Briarwood/Pixie copies) are excluded. **Id convention.** The record and the Merry Vale guide cite `ucdt`/`ugdt` hash keys (e.g. 852989007). Those resolve through `refs:FreeRealmsLocaleTools/test/FreeRealmsLocaleTools.Tests/data/en_us_data.dat`. The `locale` tool uses separate numeric ids (e.g. 41659). Both are given below. ## 1. Ambassador to Snowhill - **Title:** "Ambassador to Snowhill", locale **41659**; hash ucdt 852989007 (dat:22495). n9500000410.quest_dossier:
# Quests of Mugwopp (Merry Vale)

## Summary

Mugwopp (npc 9500000410, name string 46207, Lxzxrus Npcs Id 2301) gives one unbuilt quest, **How Bad is it?**. The record's `quests_given_text` lists **Misplaced Mugwopp**, but every source says Blorple gives that one. Mugwopp is its goal (the "find" target). I give both: How Bad is it? as Mugwopp's own quest, and Misplaced Mugwopp as the record's listed quest with the giver corrected. Neither is in `data/content/quests/*.json`. Searching for the title id 1862904283, the title 46211 / 390259 and "How Bad" found nothing there.

Locale note: the `locale` tool takes the numeric string ids (e.g. 46211, 390259). The notes and dat files use ucdt hash keys (e.g. 1862904283, 4011159409, 727442162). Where I give both, the text matched.

---

wiki.title: Stone Heart
wiki.text:
Stone Heart is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Festival of Hearts. He is a heart-shaped monster, his main goal while arrived is to destroy the Love Potions in Merry Vale which will break all the people's love.

Biography
Before the Festival of Hearts, Rylan and Arianna who were two lovers met long ago and came together near a flower that grew every time they were near each other. One day, dark magic fell over the land and Rylan never showed up again. He went out on the day of dark magic, he got turned into Stone Heart. He gathered the changelings around him. Stone Heart has no love and sees the festival as an insult. He will try to crush as much of the special magic as he can so others will be as lonely as he is.

Battle
Open World
During the time that Stone Heart is arrived, bring sadness and the feeling of heart break to all the people in love. He will slowly walk along the pathways of Merry Vale giving players time to confront the boss, the Love Potions appear on the pathways of Merry Vale. The Love Potions temporarily grant players an enchanted bow with the ability to attack Stone Heart and stop the Heart Breakers from stealing Valentine Love.

Once defeated, Stone Heart drops a special treasure chest that rewards the players that assisted in that specific battle a Festival of Hearts themed item. If he wins, he will successfully destroy the Love Potion that will break all the people's love and disappear which him and the Heart Breakers ruin the Festival of Hearts in Merry Vale, which will not drop anything.

# Quests of Tyra (Merry Vale)

## Summary

Only one unbuilt quest chain is evidenced for Tyra (npc 9500000430). Its title is **"Everyone's a Diva"**, not the "not found" in the record: the live title sits at locale tool id 46698 / .dat key 2095947265, between the cut twin "NOT LIVE - Everyone's a Diva" (46693) and the chain's own objectives. That placement is inference by adjacency, not a quoted link.

Two correction points for the record:
- **Joona gives the chain, not Tyra.** The offer is spoken by Joona ("Please speak to Tyra for me", 46692). Tyra is the target of the "Speak with Tyra" and "Return to Tyra" steps. Her NPC role as quest giver is doubtful for this chain.

wiki.title: Abacus Coinmiser
wiki.text:
Abacus Coinmiser was an elderly human NPC that was no longer in-game. Originally, he could be found near Coin Farmer Dang Dang in Sanctuary from October 8, 2013 through December 18, 2013.

Abacus's dialogue mentioned of a coin crash approaching due to inflation based on the bank minting too many coins, warning players to spend all of their coins before they are worthless.

Dialogues

Gallery

Trivia
On October 7, 2013, Free Realms Producer Steve "Shock" George tweeted a pre-release teaser image featuring Abacus.
The meaning of "Abacus Coinmiser" is to count, but avoid spending, earned coins.
The name "Abacus" refers to an ancient calculating tool, of the same name, that is widely used by merchants in eastern continents.
The name "Coinmiser" is a compound of the words: "coin", as in money; and "Miser", reluctance of spending.

# Quests of Belladonna (Sanctuary) ## Quest giver: Belladonna (npc_id 9500000447, name string 7653 / client name id 2508931447) Only one quest is listed for her (`quests_given_text`: "Honey test in the Forgotten Caves (472649836, 1979376524)"). It is not built: no hit for 472649836, 1979376524 or Belladonna under `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/`. The guide title "Honey test" is not a client string. The client title is **"Changelings' Dinner"**, found as a separate string, so the guide label is a guide inference. ### Changelings' Dinner (Belladonna, Sanctuary / Memorial Caverns; Forgotten Caves honey test) **Title** - "Changelings' Dinner": locale tool id **18120**; dat `416726506 ugdt` (`locale/en_us_data.dat:11014`). Same text as `3460382825 ucdt` (`:91659`). The title match is by wording and the quest's dinner theme, so it is (R). **Prerequisites** - Level, job and earlier quest: unknown. Not stated in any source. - Giver location: Memorial Caverns (`NPCs - Sanctuary.md:112`; `sanctuary.json:4539`). - The honey-test line is first person but has no adjacent title binding (`notes/Autopilot/T280.md:84`). So the offer link to Belladonna is evidenced by the name in the text ("Belladonna wants...", "Belladonna will then see..."), not by a binding table. **Intro / offer text** - `385651544 ucdt` = locale **15249**: "Belladonna wants to try something to help the changelings' sensitivity to sunlight." # Quests of Bixie Queen (Sanctuary)

## Bixie Queen (npc 9500000452, name 1039808409): one unbuilt quest, "Bixies Gone Bad" (rescue the Queen)

Only one quest is evidenced for this NPC. The NPC record lists one rescue goal. It is not built: no file in `quests/*.json` cites the title (1823028492), the intro (2785360215), the objective (1777163323) or the Queen's name. The Bixie Hive dungeon is built (`data/content/dungeons/bixie_hive.json:286-295` cites the goal 1777163323), but no quest record links to it.

### Quest 1: "Bixies Gone Bad" (rescue the Queen in the Bixie Hive)

**Title.** "Bixies Gone Bad": locale 15335 (tool id), hash `1823028492` ucdt (`FreeRealmsLocaleTools/test/FreeRealmsLocaleTools.Tests/data/en_us_data.dat:48141`; same in `opening-journal-text-v2/locale/en_us_data.dat:48153`). A separate string, "NOT LIVE - Bixies Gone Bad" (`781507191`, data .dat:20577), suggests the title was once marked not live. The title is not tied to any guide, so its link to this quest is by adjacency only.

**Offer (intro) text.** Locale 15888, hash `2785360215` ucdt:
> "Some bixies have gone bad and have captured the Queen! You must help her! Go into the Bixie Hives and save her before it is too late."
(`.dat:73385`). The offer's speaker is not named. The Hive guide cites this text as a companion of the main rescue (`notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Bixie Hive.md:97`).

- Locale 15339 / hash `1068589297`: "Save the bixie queen in the Bixie Hive next to Sanctuary." (`.dat:28310`). This is the location hint.

wiki.title: Bruce
wiki.text:
Bruce is a semiretired human NPC rockstar well known for his past performances in Snowhill and Wugachug. Bruce is currently located in Queensfields, Sanctuary as a merchant.

Performances
Snowhill 2009
thumb|300px|Bruce at Snowhill
During the first months of Free Realms after launch in April 2009, Bruce had been located on the Snowhill Stage where he performed an endless loop of the Free Realms theme song, "It's your world" covered by The Dares.

The 1M Party
On Friday May 15, 2009 at 5pm Pacific Time, the Free Realms Ambassador team held a bash at Snowhill in celebration of Free Realms reaching one million registered users within 17 days of launch. The event reported to have had tons of players visiting Snowhill to hang out, dance and have a party. Crowds of players from the party had reached out all around the area, and eventually formed a crowd around Bruce, who had been performing on the nearby Snowhill stage at the time.

The Dares
Bruce had held solid on his performance for many months and up to early June 2009 as he went on tour, leaving the Snowhill Stage vacant at the time The Dares held their Live E3 Performance on June 2, 2009.

Wugachug 2009
On June 5, 2009 Bruce made his appearance on the Wugachug Stage, where he continued to perform his endless loop of "It's your world". Bruce had continued performing on the Wugachug Stage until he was removed on August 14, 2009. August 14, 2009 was also the day of the update that Free Realms went international, possibly directly linking to his removal as the song "It's your world" covered by The Dares is only available in the English language. It was then said that Bruce had semiretired from performing.

wiki.title: Cakenstein
wiki.text:
Cakenstein is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Birthday Bash. He is a mutant-like walking cake that appears during the only Birthday Bash and in Treasure War. His main goal is to eat the cakes made for the birthday of Free Realms. Cakenstein was created by a robgoblin chef, Glerga. He is often accompanied by cakelings.

Battle
Open World
During the Birthday Bash, a message will pop up saying  "Cakenstein has risen in <Warpstone>". While Cakenstein is risen, fireworks appear in crates on the pathways of eight locations near Cakenstein. You must fire fireworks at him, but while fighting him, he will run around the area, eating the cakes and getting stronger while doing it.

Cakenstein can also spawn cakelings which bring cake to him. If they succeed, Cakenstein will becomes invincible for a short amount of time.

Once defeated, Cakenstein will melt and drop piles of cakes and a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Birthday Bash reward. If he wins, he will successfully eat birthday cakes and disappear, and he will not drop anything.

Cakenstein Attacks!
Cakenstein appears in Queensfields, located in just outside Sanctuary. This battle requires you to be level 13 or higher to start. Cakenstein is trying to eat more birthday cakes, and you must stop him before he becomes any stronger. During the battle he spawns cakelings which will attack you. He also seems to have a weakness of the Fire Power-Up if you use Fire Power-Up to attack him.

Dialogues

Boss Cake
Cakenstein is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.

Appearances
Free Realms 2nd Birthday Yearbook Video

Quest:Perfecting the Batter
Quest:All Cakensteins Must Die

# Quests of Camellia (Sanctuary)

## Camellia (npc 9500000461, Sanctuary, Birthday Bash party planner)

Not the Arch Druid Camellia (`npcs/shrouded_glade.json` 9500000650). The guides say so too: `NPCs - Shrouded Glade.md:121` and `:167`. No quest for this NPC is built yet. `quests/*.json` has no "A Piece of Cake", "Undelivered Confections" or "Birthday Cake Bake-Off". The only hit is `vendors_unresolved.json:10404` ("Quest:A Piece of Cake"), an unresolved vendor reference.

Three quests are listed. Ordered by evidence: A Piece of Cake, then Undelivered Confections, then Birthday Cake Bake-Off.

---

### 1. A Piece of Cake (daily, Birthday Bash only)

- **Title:** locale 428037 "A Piece of Cake". Locale-dump title id ucdt 409701653 (`refs: opening-journal-text-v2/locale/en_us_data.dat:10843`).
- **Offer / detail:** locale 428035 "Camellia, the royal party planner, wants you to grab a slice of today's daily baked good." Wiki summary matches (`refs: freerealms-wiki/quest-pages.json:115`).
- **Objective text:** locale 428480 "Camellia, the royal party planner, wants you to grab a cupcake." Objective lines: 428481 "Grab a cupcake" and 428483 "Return to Camellia".

  1. Speak to Camellia in Sanctuary. Text 428033: "Hey, [*player*]! Did you grab a cupcake today? No? Well, you should!" (wiki: `freerealms-wiki/wikitext/9869-28956-4a0a7f005388.wiki:15-16`).
  2. Grab a cupcake: select the floating tray of cupcakes near Camellia (wiki `:17-18`). Item id not resolved; locale 4895 "Cupcake" is the only item-name hit.
  3. Return to Camellia (428483).
  4. Completion: Camellia's text 428036 "Oh, you ate the last cupcake? I hope it tasted delicious! It looks like we'll need to pick up another order of cakes." (wiki `:19-20`). This hands off to Undelivered Confections.

Doctor Gordon is a human NPC that can be found in Sanctuary. Some of his quests are part of the Medic Job quest series. He will not offer additional medic quests until the Medic Job quest series has been completed. # Quests of Florina (Sanctuary)

## Verdict: Florina gives no quest of her own

The `quests_given_text` entry for Florina, "Pick up a gift from Florina in Sanctuary" (3523981689), is not a quest title. It is one **pick-up objective line** of the Briarwood Chapter 1 quest **"Chapter 1: Pampered Pets"**, which is already built. wiki.text:
Geoffrey is a pixie NPC featured as the main antagonist of the main questline. He is also the recurring antagonist of the Free Realms comic series. He works under Queen Valerian, through working for her, he uses his high stats for greed. Geoffrey had assassinated Queen Valerian's and Darkthorne's parents.

Geoffrey is also an NPC boss in The Queen's Last Hope. He use to fight with Gloam magic when the player fight him. After this, he fails and got defeated the player. Later the player saves the queen.

In the Free Realms comic series, however, the two main protagonists, Dane and Maya are together with Darkthorne to saves Queen Valerian from Geoffrey.

wiki.title: Necronomicus
wiki.text:
Necronomicus is a fairy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Southern Wilds chapter of the Heroes Journal. He is the Gloam Lord of Necromancy, and is currently the only Gloam Lord in the game at this time. He mainly resides in the Fairy Cultist territory.

Quest
Mysterious Stranger
During the quest named Bixie-B-Gone, a mysterious NPC with the name plate, the Mysterious Stranger is found near the missing caravan. It is later found out the Mysterious Stranger had been Necronomicus.

Locations
Necronomicus (Temporary Quest NPC)
A little bit south of Queensfields next to the missing caravan. Disappears once talked to.

Necronomicus (Battle Boss NPC)
May be found in the battle "Necronomicus Unleashed" which can only be unlocked by getting the quest "Necronomicus Unleashed" from the Fighter's Guild Message Board in Sanctuary.

Necronomicus (Overworld Enemy NPC)
May be found via a secret passage that the player may only gain access to after completing a certain quest in the Heroes Journal.

Versions
There are two different Necronomicus enemy versions and an intractable Necronomicus NPC that can only be interacted with once in order to complete a quest for the Southern Wilds questline.

Battle

thumb|300px|Necronomicus' skeletal form
This is Necronomicus Unleashed, the difficulty 5 battle. As its description suggests, this battle is designed as a group assault, and it will require you to encounter Necronomicus in a battle which requires you to be level 13 combat job or above to enter. Through progression of the Heroes Journal Merry Vale quest, a Overworld combat battle will become available during the quest named Unmasking the Villain.

# Quests of Necronomicus (Sanctuary)

# Necronomicus (npc_id 9500000508, name string 440729): quest dossier

**Headline:** None of the quests in the record is given by this NPC. "Necronomicus Unleashed" is offered from the Fighter's Guild message board in Sanctuary (wiki). The Mysterious Stranger is a temporary NPC inside Bixie-B-Gone, whose giver is Sergeant Larkspur. Necronomicus is the quest's **target and boss**, not its giver. No quest in `quests/*.json` covers either quest (searched "Necronomicus", "858689397", "442596", "Bixie-B-Gone": no hits). Both are unbuilt.

---

## 1. Necronomicus Unleashed (unbuilt; the record's quest)

**Title.** `442596` "Necronomicus Unleashed" (client hash 858689397, as the record cites). The same text is `442316` "Necronomicus Unleashed", which names the battle or instance in the client.

**Giver.** Fighter's Guild message board, Sanctuary. Evidence: wiki `freerealms-wiki/wikitext/16877-50130-b385ebd250b0.wiki` line 23 ("can only be unlocked by getting the quest 'Necronomicus Unleashed' from the Fighter's Guild Message Board in Sanctuary"). Client: `442218` "Message Board", `442219` "Fighter's Guild". The board has no NPC id. The record's claim that Necronomicus (9500000508) gives it is not supported by the evidence. Source: `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Sanctuary.md` line 121 and `notes/Build Guides/Content/Dungeons/Necronomicus Unleashed.md` line 32.

**Prerequisites.**
- Heroes Journal Southern Wilds, Merry Vale part. The wiki says the battle becomes available during "Unmasking the Villain" (wiki 16877 line 34). Quest titles: `441746` "Unmasking the Villain"; `441899` "SGRevamp - Wilds South - 4-5 - Unmasking the Villain"; `442016` "Complete Unmasking the Villain." Whether it is a hard prerequisite is **(R)**.

wiki.title: Pumpkin Prince
wiki.text:
The Pumpkin Prince is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Super Spooktacular. He is the pumpkin monster, his main goal while arrived is to terrorizing the four locations, though his goal was said to rule all of Sacred Grove.

Battle
Open World
During the Super Spooktacular, a message will pop up saying "The Pumpkin Prince is terrorizing in <Warpstone>". While the Pumpkin Prince is arrived, ectoplasmic destabilizer dispseners appear on the pathways of four locations which you will find somewhere near where the Pumpkin Prince is (he is walking around somewhere in that area and anyone can attack him). All you must do is keep firing at him with your ectoplasmic shooter which will be at the bottom of your screen where your combat moves are.

The Pumpkin Prince can spawn undead enemies such as grave elementals or necrowart zombies that will attack you with effects that slow you down. The Pumpkin Prince can also attack you with himself and if he strikes you will be turned into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter ability. You will have to pick up another one when the effect wears off.

Once defeated, he will cry a call in defeat and drop a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Super Spooktacular reward. If he wins he will cry a call of victory and will not drop anything.

Bone Bog Cemetery
The Pumpkin Prince appears in the Bone Bog Cemetery, located in Blackspore Swamp during the Super Spooktacular, which at one point will require you to encounter him in a battle which requires you to be level 13 combat job or above to enter. You going to the dungeon with Lucinda. You will go to fight against the Pumpkin Prince, and send his undead army back to the ghost world. The Pumpkin Prince also spawn the ghosts which will heal him in a battle

wiki.title: Queen Valerian
wiki.text:
Queen Valerian is the queen of Sanctuary, sister to Darkthorne, and the ruler of all the pixies scattered across Sacred Grove. She is a direct descendant of Ayani, the legendary heroine who sprouted the Heartseed, Queen Valerian's home.

She began ruling over Sanctuary after her parents had been assassinated and her sister Princess Lavender exiled to Briarheart due to the fact that Princess Lavender was blamed by Geoffrey for poisoning her sister, though he was the real culprit. She lives a regal but sad life for her family has been separated and the only people who are close to her are her loyal servants along with Geoffrey, who is secretly plotting against her (although after the player completes the Royal questline, the player confronts Geoffrey and finds out that he poisoned her parents). Members in Sanctuary can enter a party that teleports you behind the Pixiewood Hills sign, if you get inside you can eat a cupcake consumable and appear as Queen Valerian.

wiki.title: Rio Cloudjumps
wiki.text:
Rio Cloudjumps is a human wizard NPC that can be found near the Sanctuary warpstone.

Biography 
Rio was hired to cleanout the Royal Vault. His method for doing so consisting of transferring all of the coins to another dimension known as the Cloud World, where he had miscalculated and the coins began to overload the clouds causing the clouds to overflow into Sanctuary. Rio can be seen on a hilltop attempting to remove the overflowing clouds, offering players the chance to assist in removing coins from the Cloud World through completing the daily quest known as Cloudy Days.

Sam Potts is a card duelist trainer and archer that can be found in Sanctuary. She will start you on your quest to level up and train you to be a card duelist. She trained her cousin (an archer and one of the four Realmkeepers, Jessica) to become a cardie. She works for Quills, but lately she wants to start getting back in TCG Tournaments.

Deck

n9000000190.quest_dossier:
# Quests of Sandbur (Sanctuary)

## Result: every quest Sandbur gives is already built

Sandbur (npc_id 9000000190, name_string_id 2247542797, Sanctuary Inner Circle) is the giver of two quests. Both are already in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/wizard.json`, so no new dossier is needed.

| Quest | Locale title id | Built record | Giver in record |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wizard: Searching for the Past | 22364 | id 3160020 (wizard.json:1070-1119) | 9000000190 (Sandbur) |
| Wizard: Crystal Clear Delivery | 74972 | id 3160021 (wizard.json:1120-1171) | 9000000190 (Sandbur) |

Both match `quest_ids_given` in the record ([3160020, 3160021]).

### Not a Sandbur-given quest: Wizard: Filling in the Gaps

The record's text ("receives the opal gems in Wizard: Filling in the Gaps") names Sandbur only as the turn-in target. The quest is given by Iliya.
- Title: locale 74996 "Wizard: Filling in the Gaps". Intro 74995, description 74997, end text 74998 per the built record.
- Built as id 3160023 with `giver_npc_id` 9000000108. That id is Iliya in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/blackspore_swamp.json:15699-15705`.
- Guide: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Wizard.md:106` (row 21, "Iliya, Mire's Edge"). The guide's text on the gem hand-in is "Take the opal gems to Sandbur in Sanctuary." (3593443539).
- Sanctuary guide, `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Sanctuary.md:61`, also says Sandbur only "receives the opal gems."

### Other Sandbur-adjacent quests (not his to give)
- Wizard: Helping a Friend (built as wizard.json around line 1027) is given by Osgood. Its text sends the player to Sandbur, but it is not his quest.
- Wizard: Things Left Unfinished (built as 3160022) is given by Iliya.

## Gaps
- No unbuilt quest is given by Sandbur, so there is no intro, objective

Pet Party

wiki.title: Cragara
wiki.text:
Cragara, also known as the Mysterious Merchant, is a mysterious NPC merchant that appears at locations at random offering items at random.

Generally Cragara sells items that vary from regular SC Marketplace items with large discount prices, exclusive content that isn't available through the SC Marketplace, and SC Marketplace items at store price but available in rare, exclusive colors.

Cragara is constantly relocating her shop and is not always available in Free Realms. She only offers the opportunity to purchase 4-6 different items at random and in limited quantity at each relocation.

Cragara's Shop Closed

Originally Cragara's shops were closed upon the in-game introduction of late 2012. When activated, Cragara provided dialogue explaining that she was resting after a long journey from Black Forest, an area that is located east of Stillwater Crossing.

Locations
Cragara spawns in the six following locations: Seaside, Merry Vale, Snowhill, Blackspore Swamp, Briarwood, and Sunstone Valley.

Items Cragara sells

 

 

Gallery

Trivia
Cragara is currently the only known snail in Free Realms.
However there is a snail guard in one of Free Realms roster arts we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Cragara's kind.

# Quests of Diggy (Seaside)

# Diggy (npc 9000000070, Ocean Treasures Cafe, Seaside): quest dossier

**Scope.** No quest in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json` has giver 9000000070 or any of Diggy's title hashes (searched for "Diggy", 9000000070, 3030398973, 1798567334, 211779048, 2980787396, 1601016891, 811105456, 254473930, 2930939421, 2440607895, 1746864794). `seaside.json` has `quest_ids_given: []`. So all four quests below are unbuilt.

**Id convention.** The locale tool does not index quest titles or quest text. "Farewell Feast" and "Hasty Food" return no hits, and `locale 3030398973` returns "(no such id)". The ids the record gives are 10-digit client string keys (`ucdt`/`ugdt` hashes) from `client/locale/en_us_data.dat`. They are not the numeric ids the quest JSON uses in `title_string_id`. Each text below is cited by its hash key, and the dat line is given.

**Giver evidence.** The Diggy page in the wiki lists four quests under "Quests": Farewell Feast, Hasty Food Delivery, Bucket O'Fish (repeatable) and Helping the Local Chef (repeatable). Source: `freerealms-wiki/wikitext/9749-50114-b9e3818e2857.wiki` lines 11-15. The zone file's quest index (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Seaside.md` rows 231-234) matches. # Quests of Mr. Mudd (Seaside)

# Mr. Mudd (npc 9500000606, name string 45587, Seaside): dossier

Only one quest is attributed to Mr. Mudd: the Trash Pile clean-up. Its title is evidenced as **"Mudpie!"**, but the same string is also a native activity (minigame) record, so the builder should decide whether it is a quest or an activity. Nothing in `quests/*.json` mentions Mudd, Mudpie, Trash Pile or Trusty Shovel, so it is unbuilt.

## Quest 1: "Mudpie!" (Trash Pile clean-up)

**Title.** "Mudpie!" is locale id **389249**. Client key: ugdt 3194609522 / ucdt 4165914747. Evidence: `locale` 389249; `notes/Research/original-activity-coverage.json:10746-10765` (activity id **574**, `name_id` 389249, `description_id` 390137, type 1, difficulty 2, group 1, `restoration_status: missing-implementation`).

**Giver.** Mr. Mudd, npc 9500000606 (`prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/seaside.json:30153-30188`). Name is string 45587 (`Mr. Mudd`). Legacy Npcs.json Id 1951 (`seaside.json:~30323`, from `../lab/references/FreeRealms-Legacy/src/Scripts/Zone/FabledRealms.lua:709`).

# Quests of Muggy Wuggle (Seaside) ## Summary Muggy Wuggle (record npc_id 9500000607, Seaside, Chugawug) gives no quest that the evidence supports. The only quest-related text tied to him is a **delivery target** in Luella's ambassador chain, not a giver line. No quest has been built for him. I did not write a quest dossier, because the only candidate is a cut ("NOT LIVE") leg whose giver is Luella (see below). ## What the record's quest text actually is The record's `quests_given_text` entry, "Merry Vale ambassador target (\"a relaxing vacation to Merry Vale\", 902908073, 3325639911)", is a target note, not an offer. - **902908073** (refs dump, `opening-harvesting-native-20261009T142624Z/locale/en_us_data.dat:23924`): "Have you talked to Tozer, Muggy Wuggle, and Poco Pogo in Seaside yet? I am sure they would love a relaxing vacation to Merry Vale." This is a hint line. It names Muggy as someone to talk to, and says nothing about him giving anything. - **3325639911** (same dump, line 87945): "Speak with Muggy Wuggle about taking a vacation in Merry Vale." This is an objective line. It matches the sibling objectives "Speak with Greenthumb / Peacepetal / Starshine about taking a vacation to Merry Vale" (2771093516, 3074765659, 3092340780), which belong to Luella's legs. Muggy is the person spoken to. The same pattern shows the real chain: - **Intro, Seaside leg, id 3536021443** (dump line 93638, ucdt): "Are you up for a trip to Seaside? I need an ambassador to let all of the fine folks there know what fun they could have here in Merry Vale!

I need you to deliver personal messages to the following people: Tozer, Muggy Wuggle, and Poco Pogo." - *

# Quests of Nessi (Seaside) # Nessi (npc 9500000610, name_string 94177): quest dossier Only one quest is evidenced. The two strings in the record, "Leash Nessi" and "Remove Nessi from Piparoo's yard ... and return him to Poco Pogo", are two objective lines of one quest, **"Put a Leash on It!"**. Neither the title nor any Nessi/Piparoo text appears in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json` (no match for "Leash", "Piparoo", 4236427791 or 1986017390), so the quest is unbuilt. Ids: the locale tool uses table ids (e.g. 101468). The `.dat` files use string hashes (e.g. 1986017390). Both are given below. ## 1. Put a Leash on It! - **Title:** "Put a Leash on It!". Locale **101468**, hash **1986017390**. - Evidence: `locale` 101468; `refs:FreeRealmsLocaleTools/test/FreeRealmsLocaleTools.Tests/data/en_us_data.dat:52337` (hash 1986017390); `repo:notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Seaside.md:268` (title 1986017390, giver "Piparoo / Poco Pogo [inferred]"); the same guide, row 72 (Poco Pogo "receives Nessi back ... [inferred]"). - **Giver:** Piparoo (Pixie, Luxurious Oceanfront Homes, Seaside; name 1678644337, `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/seaside.json:33623`). Piparoo's record cites "the dog quest above". The locale text "Piparoo asked you to escort Nessi" (101476) also names Piparoo as the asker. The record's `quests_given_text` names Orchid Eventide (npc 9500000611) as the giver of "Unwanted Guests". The evidence says otherwise:

- `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Seaside.md:223`: quest index row "Unwanted Guests | Kai | title 1977161524 | Orchid Eventide fight".
- `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/seaside.json:23383-23386`: Kai (npc_id 9500000592, name_string_id 21296, roles quest_giver/trainer) lists "Unwanted Guests (title 1977161524)" among his quests.
- Wiki `freerealms-wiki/wikitext/3235-50406-b8786dce26de.wiki`, Kai page: "Quests: Ghosts of the Past, Not the Ghosts You're Looking For, Unwanted Guests, Defeat the Kraken"; category Quest Givers.
- Wiki `freerealms-wiki/wikitext/18601-49889-6a8098c92251.wiki` (Heroes Journal: The Seaside Gloam Invasion): Orchid is the boss ("go and defeat her"), and the wiki has no NPC page for her. The wiki's Orchid is a boss target, not a giver.

Orchid's own record should therefore have `quests_given: none evidenced`. The quest below is Kai's and should be filed under Kai (9500000592), with Orchid as its target. Nothing is built for it: a search of `quests/*.json` and the content tree finds no "Unwanted Guests" and no quest for Kai.

Note on ids: the `locale` tool takes its own row numbers (for example 5100946 = string 1448076284). Numeric string ids from the record (such as 1448076284) return "no such id", so the text below was found through `client` and `repo` lookups on the string ids.

# Troy Ridewrangler (npc 9500000639, Seaside, name string 440997): unbuilt quest dossier

**Scope.** Troy gives the 5-quest "Glide Training" series. None of the five is built: `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/` has no Glide or Troy entry (a search for "Glide", "Troy", "Ridewrangler" and the title hashes returned nothing in that folder). The four most evidenced quests are written up below (cap of 4). "Glide Training: License to Glide" is the fifth and is listed in Gaps with its ids.

**Id note.** The record's title hashes (487749906 etc.) are the keys in the shipped `en_us_data.dat` (e.g. `refs:opening-journal-text-v2/locale/en_us_data.dat:12969  487749906  ucdt  Glide Training: Getting Started`). The `locale` tool reports the same strings under different ids (4419680 etc.). Both are given below. The locale ids follow a pattern: for quest n the title, intro and completion sit at 4 consecutive ids, and the step-dialogue and objective strings sit next to them.

**Shared facts for the series** (all quests):
- Giver: Troy Ridewrangler, "near the Seaside Warpstone" (wiki Goals/To Start). Client line 441985 says "outside of the ride stable in Seaside"; 4419712 says "near the ride corral in Seaside". Name string 440997 ("Troy Ridewrangler"). Repo NPC record: npc_id 9500000639. The Seaside guide lists a different name id (1290590531, `repo:notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Seaside.md:60`); unresolved.
- Series is five quests, each one day after the previous completion (wiki `refs:freerealms-wiki/wikitext/9696-45171-8406a8a2fef6.wiki`; `refs:freerealms-wiki/wikitext/9633-27858-9e2de906e051.wiki` line 5).

# Quests of Brickface (Shrouded Glade)

## Brickface (npc_id 9500000655, Shrouded Glade): no quest to build

**Verdict: nothing found.** Brickface gives no quest. He is a mini-boss of the Gloam invasion, and the only "quest" text on his record is a respawn rule, not a quest.

### What the evidence shows

- **Role.** The wiki Shrouded Glade page lists Brickface under "Battles", not under quests. It says: "The remaining battles, the mini-bosses, respawn 15 minutes after the last mini boss was beat. Only one mini boss appears at a time, and they are found in one of three locations: the stairs to the north wing of the academy, the stairs to the south wing or near the greenhouses across from the south wing entrance." It then lists Druid/Dwarf Rally, Gloamtooth, Marius Shadetree, Brickface and General Drahk. (`refs: freerealms-wiki/wikitext/9545-48900-ffebdcdd728a.wiki:43-51`)
- **Our guide row.** `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Shrouded Glade.md:142` puts Brickface with Gloamtooth and Marius Shadetree as "Mini-bosses of the invasion". Its quest column says only "Mini-boss respawn 15 minutes after the last (wiki)". That is the same respawn rule, not a quest.
- **Drops.** The chest "Only players that helped defeat Brickface can use this chest." (locale 4262166742; also "Brickface's Treasure Chest" 3531836931 / 3800557172) and the illusion "Illusion: Brickface - 3 minutes" (locale 2121156756) are battle rewards. They are not quest rewards.
- **Locale.** Every locale hit for "Brickface" is a name, a chest, an illusion, a Gloam Rock transform ("Use the Gloam Rock to turn into Brickface." 1764654203), or an ability/buff ("Brickface's Gloamstone" 647188048 / 1566583248, "Brickface's Stun" 1687434962 / 1692534506).
