wiki.title: Cakenstein
wiki.text:
Cakenstein is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Birthday Bash. He is a mutant-like walking cake that appears during the only Birthday Bash and in Treasure War. His main goal is to eat the cakes made for the birthday of Free Realms. Cakenstein was created by a robgoblin chef, Glerga. He is often accompanied by cakelings.

Battle
Open World
During the Birthday Bash, a message will pop up saying  "Cakenstein has risen in <Warpstone>". While Cakenstein is risen, fireworks appear in crates on the pathways of eight locations near Cakenstein. You must fire fireworks at him, but while fighting him, he will run around the area, eating the cakes and getting stronger while doing it.

Cakenstein can also spawn cakelings which bring cake to him. If they succeed, Cakenstein will becomes invincible for a short amount of time.

Once defeated, Cakenstein will melt and drop piles of cakes and a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Birthday Bash reward. If he wins, he will successfully eat birthday cakes and disappear, and he will not drop anything.

Cakenstein Attacks!
Cakenstein appears in Queensfields, located in just outside Sanctuary. This battle requires you to be level 13 or higher to start. Cakenstein is trying to eat more birthday cakes, and you must stop him before he becomes any stronger. During the battle he spawns cakelings which will attack you. He also seems to have a weakness of the Fire Power-Up if you use Fire Power-Up to attack him.

Dialogues

Boss Cake
Cakenstein is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.

Appearances

# Quests of Cakenstein (Shrouded Glade)

## Cakenstein (npc_id 9500000656, name_string_id 5102905), Shrouded Glade

**Result: no quests to build for this NPC.** The record's own `quests_given_text` is "Event fight only." and `quest_ids_given` is empty. Every source I checked agrees that Cakenstein is a Birthday Bash boss, not a quest giver.

### Evidence
- **Record:** `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/shrouded_glade.json:4670-4705`. `roles` lists `quest_giver` and `enemy`, but `quests_given` and `quest_ids_given` are both empty. `quests_accepted_reason` says no explicit hand-in was isolated.
- **Zone guide:** `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Shrouded Glade.md:144`. The row reads "Birthday Bash boss". It names the spawn text (1210460181), "Birthday Party in Shrouded Glade" (2372888813) and the hide-and-seek party line (1496682435). It lists no quest.
- **Other zone rows:** `NPCs - Merry Vale.md:128` gives "Event fight", with "None" in the quest column. `NPCs - Blackspore Swamp.md:119` gives "Event boss" with "None" in the same column.
- **Wiki, Cakenstein page:** `refs:freerealms-wiki/wikitext/2426-49987-d3dcbf5d9567.wiki:8-16`. He is a boss who spawns in the open world. Fireworks crates appear near him, and a treasure chest drops when he is defeated. Nothing in the page describes him giving a quest.
- **Wiki, Birthday Bash page:** `refs:freerealms-wiki/wikitext/7912-44814-fd93476b7f62.wiki:4-23` and `:37-53`. The quest list has no Shrouded Glade giver tied to Cakenstein. The "Vs. Cakenstein" section describes a live minigame, and Shrouded Glade is only one of the spawn towns.

# Quests of Marius Shadetree (Shrouded Glade)

## Marius Shadetree (npc_id 9500000701): no quest to build

**Verdict:** Marius Shadetree does not give a quest. The `quest_giver` role in the record is a misclassification. The "quests_given_text" entry is a respawn schedule for a mini-boss battle, not a quest. No quest is evidenced for him, so there is no dossier entry to build.

### What the evidence shows

- **Role is a battle, not a quest.** The wiki Gloam page says: "The remaining battles, the mini-bosses, respawn 15 minutes after the last mini boss was beat. Only one mini boss appears at a time, and they are found in one of three locations: the stairs to the north wing of the academy, the stairs to the south wing or near the greenhouses across from the south wing entrance." It lists "Marius Shadetree" under the heading **Battles**, next to Gloamtooth, Brickface, the Druid/Dwarf Rally and General Drahk. Its "Quests given" column is the respawn text, and its "Gives" column is the chest and illusion. The record's `quests_given_text` copies that column. # Quests of Perci Perriweather (Shrouded Glade)

## Summary

Perci Perriweather (npc_id 9500000708) gives no quest that I can evidence under her own name. The only unbuilt quest tied to her is the **Potions for the Arch Druid** chain. The client's text shows **Ceard Bauchlog** as the one asking for the potion ("Ceard wants you to get a potion from Perci", "...for Ceard Bauchlog"). Perci is the shop where the potion is bought, and the place that redirects the player to Daphne when she is out of stock. The record's `quests_given_text` and `roles: quest_giver` overstate her role. Treat her as a vendor and redirect node in this chain, and record Ceard as the quest giver, unless a source shows Perci's own offer.

The Card Duelist stop it cites ("Visit Perci in Shrouded Glade", 1457307539; Misty Mountain Fizz, 1483953870 / 2518614605 / 3935063848) belongs to **Card Duelist: Cardie Party**, which Bry gives. That quest is already built (see Already built below).

wiki.title: Queen Valerian
wiki.text:
Queen Valerian is the queen of Sanctuary, sister to Darkthorne, and the ruler of all the pixies scattered across Sacred Grove. She is a direct descendant of Ayani, the legendary heroine who sprouted the Heartseed, Queen Valerian's home.

She began ruling over Sanctuary after her parents had been assassinated and her sister Princess Lavender exiled to Briarheart due to the fact that Princess Lavender was blamed by Geoffrey for poisoning her sister, though he was the real culprit. She lives a regal but sad life for her family has been separated and the only people who are close to her are her loyal servants along with Geoffrey, who is secretly plotting against her (although after the player completes the Royal questline, the player confronts Geoffrey and finds out that he poisoned her parents). Members in Sanctuary can enter a party that teleports you behind the Pixiewood Hills sign, if you get inside you can eat a cupcake consumable and appear as Queen Valerian.

# Quests of Venomlord Breinne Ultrafang (Shrouded Glade)

## Scope

Venomlord Breinne Ultrafang (npc_id 9500000722, Shrouded Glade, druid camp) gives two unbuilt quests in the Druid arc: **Essssspionage** and **Slithering Agents**. Neither title appears in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json`. A search for "Essssspionage", "Slithering", "Viper" and the title hashes found no hits there. wiki.title: Abominable Snowman
wiki.text:
The Abominable Snowman is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Snow Days. He is the giant snow monster, his main goal while arrived is to stealing presents in Snowhill which all the people will be upset.

Open World Battle
During the Snow Days, a message will pop up saying "Snowman Invaders are stealing presents in Snowhill". While the Abominable Snowman is arrived, the snowball piles appear on the pathways of Snowhill which you will find somewhere near where the Abominable Snowman is. Bring snowballs to throw him and stop the snowmen from stealing presents.

Once defeated, the Abominable Snowman drops a special treasure chest that rewards the players that assisted in that specific battle a Snow Days themed item. If he wins, he will successfully stealing presents that will make all the people upset and disappear, which will not drop anything.

Dialogues

TCG
220px|right
In December 2012 during the Snow Days, a Trading Card Game promotional Hero card was introduced based on Abominable Snowman in a Heroes TCG Bundle. The bundle contained two Baron von Darkcheat Booster Packs, two Heroes Booster Packs, and one Abominable Snowman promo card. The card's ID is 4P24.

Boss Cake
The Abominable Snowman is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.

Appearances
Free Realms Holiday TV Spot
Trading Card Game Series 4
Free Realms Snow Days Commercial

Gallery

Trivia
Unlike the three seasonal bosses, the Abominable Snowman is the only seasonal boss that didn't have the combat minigame. 

Sources
December Update Preview, Pt. 2 on Official Free Realms Blog
It's the Meatiest!: FreeRealms on It's the Meatiest (The online portfolio of Steve Merghart)

**Summary.** Nothing in `quests/*.json` names Bert, the Snowhill NPC record, or any of these strings, so both quests below are unbuilt. Neither has a confirmed title or a confirmed giver. The wiki cache has no Bert quest page, so the record's "wiki-only quest links" are not in `refs`. The evidence is client locale text only. Locale keys below are the `locale` tool's row numbers; the string ids are the `ucdt`/`ugdt` ids in the `en_us_data.dat` dumps (`refs`, `opening-harvesting-native-20261009T142624Z`, and the same strings in the other dumps).

## Quest A (candidate): "NOT LIVE - Penguin Problems"

- **Title:** "NOT LIVE - Penguin Problems", string id 236310022 ugdt, locale key 3468. The "NOT LIVE" prefix means the title is a pre-release string. No live title is tied to these texts.

Loryn is the speaker in "Loryn has told you that Snowhill is having all sorts of problems with their new Penguin Mailmen. Head over to Bert and see if you can straighten things out." (string 4140025866 ucdt, locale key 3467). Bert is the target, not the giver, so Quest A does not support the record's "quest_giver" role.

- **Objective:** "Find Bert", string 3386481843 ucdt, locale key 3469.
- **Completion:** "You found Bert!", string 698379146 ucdt, locale key 3471.
- **Steps:** (1) talk to Loryn in Snowhill (offer); (2) find Bert the penguin mailman, whose client name is 421549771 "Bert the mailman" (NPC record, `npcs/snowhill.json` line ~2221); (3) Bert is found, which completes the quest.

- 3260595528 (locale index 22771): "There have been some complaints in Snowhill regarding bats flying out of the mines. Brody Sparfist would like for you to clear out some of these bats from the Bat Caves."

wiki.title: Bruce
wiki.text:
Bruce is a semiretired human NPC rockstar well known for his past performances in Snowhill and Wugachug. Bruce is currently located in Queensfields, Sanctuary as a merchant.

Performances
Snowhill 2009
thumb|300px|Bruce at Snowhill
During the first months of Free Realms after launch in April 2009, Bruce had been located on the Snowhill Stage where he performed an endless loop of the Free Realms theme song, "It's your world" covered by The Dares.

The 1M Party
On Friday May 15, 2009 at 5pm Pacific Time, the Free Realms Ambassador team held a bash at Snowhill in celebration of Free Realms reaching one million registered users within 17 days of launch. The event reported to have had tons of players visiting Snowhill to hang out, dance and have a party. Crowds of players from the party had reached out all around the area, and eventually formed a crowd around Bruce, who had been performing on the nearby Snowhill stage at the time.

The Dares
Bruce had held solid on his performance for many months and up to early June 2009 as he went on tour, leaving the Snowhill Stage vacant at the time The Dares held their Live E3 Performance on June 2, 2009.

Wugachug 2009
On June 5, 2009 Bruce made his appearance on the Wugachug Stage, where he continued to perform his endless loop of "It's your world". Bruce had continued performing on the Wugachug Stage until he was removed on August 14, 2009. August 14, 2009 was also the day of the update that Free Realms went international, possibly directly linking to his removal as the song "It's your world" covered by The Dares is only available in the English language. It was then said that Bruce had semiretired from performing.

# Quests of Bruce (Snowhill)

## Bruce (npc_id 9500000729, Snowhill): no quests to build

**Verdict:** Bruce gives no quests. The record's `quest_giver` role and empty `quest_ids_given` are not supported by any source. I built no quest dossier for him.

### Evidence that Bruce is not a quest giver
- `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Snowhill.md:33` lists Bruce (ucdt 255196100 and others) as "Rockstar who performed on the Snowhill stage. Not a quest giver." Its quest column reads "None. Flynn's quests are about his noise and dressing-room demands."
- The wiki cache (`refs`, `freerealms-wiki/quest-pages.json`) has no quest whose giver is Bruce. The Noise Permit page (line 161) says "Speak with Flynn located in Snowhill", and the Noisy Neighbors page (line 154) starts with Clara Chatterhag. Bruce appears only as the subject of the complaint ("Talk to Flynn about Bruce's noise level").
- Client locale, dressing-room errand: id 36721 "Here we go again. Bruce is demanding more items for his dressing room... Say... can you collect the items for me?" is spoken by Flynn. Id 36723 "Bruce, the rockstar in Snowhill, has a strange list of demands for his dressing room. Flynn has asked you to collect the items for Bruce." confirms Flynn is the giver.
- Other Bruce lines are dialogue or pass text, not offers: 201, 700–702 (Offstage Pass), 36029–36043 (fan chatter), 9823 (autographed picture), 77774/77776 (Thugawug Sneak rescue).
- The Snowhill guide's Flynn row (line 31) lists "Concert-stage errands for Bruce (see Bruce)" as Flynn's quest content.

### Where the actual quests sit
- **Noise Permit** (title locale 511573328): giver Flynn, per the wiki (`quest-pages.json:161`). It requires Noisy Neighbors. Not a Bruce quest.

wiki.title: Cragara
wiki.text:
Cragara, also known as the Mysterious Merchant, is a mysterious NPC merchant that appears at locations at random offering items at random.

Generally Cragara sells items that vary from regular SC Marketplace items with large discount prices, exclusive content that isn't available through the SC Marketplace, and SC Marketplace items at store price but available in rare, exclusive colors.

Cragara is constantly relocating her shop and is not always available in Free Realms. She only offers the opportunity to purchase 4-6 different items at random and in limited quantity at each relocation.

Cragara's Shop Closed

Originally Cragara's shops were closed upon the in-game introduction of late 2012. When activated, Cragara provided dialogue explaining that she was resting after a long journey from Black Forest, an area that is located east of Stillwater Crossing.

Locations
Cragara spawns in the six following locations: Seaside, Merry Vale, Snowhill, Blackspore Swamp, Briarwood, and Sunstone Valley.

Items Cragara sells

 

 

Gallery

Trivia
Cragara is currently the only known snail in Free Realms.
However there is a snail guard in one of Free Realms roster arts we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Cragara's kind.

## Flynn (Snowhill Stage caretaker): quest dossier

Only one quest is given by Flynn, and it is not yet built: **Noise Permit** (original quest id 435). Nothing in `quests/*.json` mentions Flynn, Snowhill's stage, or "Noise", so it is unbuilt. The record's `quest_ids_given` is empty.

### 1. Noise Permit

**Title:** locale id **36830** "Noise Permit". Client hash key ucdt **511573328** (`client:opening-harvesting-native-20261009T142624Z/locale/en_us_data.dat:13624`). Our record's `quests_given_text` cites 511573328, which matches.

Momma Meepster is a meep NPC that can be found near the Big J's, located in Snowhill.

Misplaced Meeps
Momma Meepster hosts a quest called Misplaced Meeps in which the player is sent to locate her baby "Meeps" which are scattered across the Sacred Grove.

After completion of the Misplaced Meeps quest, Momma Meepster introduces the opportunity to adopt a Meep Pet Pal for the regular price of  and to Members at the 10% discount price of . 

Gallery

Trivia
On September 5, 2013 Free Realms Producer Steve George tweeted a teaser revealing Momma Meepster for the first time publicly. According to Steve George, Momma Meepster is a generous and loving penguin that may seem a BIT ROUGH around the edges.
Momma Meepster was introduced in-game as a part of the 8-Bit Month on September 10th, 2013.

wiki.title: Silversnow
wiki.text:
Silversnow is a pixie NPC that can be found in Snowhill. He is an elderly man who has been waiting in front of the Crystal Barrier for hundreds of years. He waited for the Crystal Barrier to open, and to finally be reunited with the Elves on the other side. Silversnow carried a box of fruitcake he had prepared for the Elves' return.

Trivia
Silversnow were supposed get to see the Elves, but it never happened before the game shut down.
Category:NPC
Category:Males
Category:Pixie
Category:Snowhill

wiki.text:
Tiger the Party Animal is a human NPC that spawns during Themed Community Event Parties. Currently there are only three types of Themed Parties: Luaus, Pet Parties, and Winter Holiday Parties.

Currently, Tiger is a merchant as of August 27, 2013. He can be found in Blackspore, Sanctuary, and Seaside where he sells Luau Party Tickets.

Quests
Quest:A Luau (repeatable)
Quest:Party for Pets (repeatable)
Quest:Winter Party (repeatable)

Parties
Luau
Referees host a Luau themed party during the summer season in a variety of locations. During these parties, Tiger will offer the A Luau quest to players.

Pet Party
Referees host Pet Parties several times a month in a variety of locations, during these parties, Tiger will offer the Party for Pets quest to players.

# Quests of Graveyard Wraith (Stillwater Crossing)

## Result: nothing unbuilt to add for this record

The record (`npc_id` 9500000789, "Graveyard Wraith", Stillwater Crossing) lists one quest, "Brawler: Graveyard Grumble". That quest is already built, and it is not given by the wraith. No new dossier is needed.

- The wraith is the boss of the Cursed Graveyard, not a giver. The record's `roles: quest_giver` and `quests_given_text` are wrong for this NPC.

wiki.title: Pumpkin Prince
wiki.text:
The Pumpkin Prince is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Super Spooktacular. He is the pumpkin monster, his main goal while arrived is to terrorizing the four locations, though his goal was said to rule all of Sacred Grove.

Battle
Open World
During the Super Spooktacular, a message will pop up saying "The Pumpkin Prince is terrorizing in <Warpstone>". While the Pumpkin Prince is arrived, ectoplasmic destabilizer dispseners appear on the pathways of four locations which you will find somewhere near where the Pumpkin Prince is (he is walking around somewhere in that area and anyone can attack him). All you must do is keep firing at him with your ectoplasmic shooter which will be at the bottom of your screen where your combat moves are.

The Pumpkin Prince can spawn undead enemies such as grave elementals or necrowart zombies that will attack you with effects that slow you down. The Pumpkin Prince can also attack you with himself and if he strikes you will be turned into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter ability. You will have to pick up another one when the effect wears off.

Once defeated, he will cry a call in defeat and drop a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Super Spooktacular reward. If he wins he will cry a call of victory and will not drop anything.

Bone Bog Cemetery
The Pumpkin Prince appears in the Bone Bog Cemetery, located in Blackspore Swamp during the Super Spooktacular, which at one point will require you to encounter him in a battle which requires you to be level 13 combat job or above to enter. You going to the dungeon with Lucinda. You will go to fight against the Pumpkin Prince, and send his undead army back to the ghost world. The Pumpkin Prince also spawn the ghosts which will heal him in a battle

wiki.title: Cactus Jake
wiki.text:
Cactus Jake is an enemy NPC boss that can be found in the Sandscale Oasis, located in Sunstone Valley. He is the leader of a band of cactus outlaws.

Sandscale Oasis
Cactus Jake and his Cactus Outlaws have taken over the manguana watering hole. While lacking hydration, the Sandscale manguana tribe have become aggressive and began attacking travelers and residents.

TCG
220px|right

wiki.title: Cragara
wiki.text:
Cragara, also known as the Mysterious Merchant, is a mysterious NPC merchant that appears at locations at random offering items at random.

Generally Cragara sells items that vary from regular SC Marketplace items with large discount prices, exclusive content that isn't available through the SC Marketplace, and SC Marketplace items at store price but available in rare, exclusive colors.

Cragara is constantly relocating her shop and is not always available in Free Realms. She only offers the opportunity to purchase 4-6 different items at random and in limited quantity at each relocation.

Cragara's Shop Closed

Originally Cragara's shops were closed upon the in-game introduction of late 2012. When activated, Cragara provided dialogue explaining that she was resting after a long journey from Black Forest, an area that is located east of Stillwater Crossing.

Locations
Cragara spawns in the six following locations: Seaside, Merry Vale, Snowhill, Blackspore Swamp, Briarwood, and Sunstone Valley.

Items Cragara sells

 

 

Gallery

Trivia
Cragara is currently the only known snail in Free Realms.
However there is a snail guard in one of Free Realms roster arts we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Cragara's kind.

# Quests of Finnerty Windchaser (Sunstone Valley) ## Finnerty Windchaser (npc 9500000816, Sunstone Valley): two unbuilt quests No quest for Finnerty is in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json` (searched "Finnerty", "Windchaser", "Sasparilla bottles", "rare bottles" and the record's ids; only hits are the NPC record and the Rumbledome dungeon note). `quest_ids_given` is empty. Both quests below are built from client strings only. **ID note.** The record's numbers (e.g. 2850531601) are client hash ids (`ucdt`). The `locale` tool does not index them ("no such id"). wiki.text:
Harley is a boar NPC that can be found in Sunstone Valley. She is a pet owned by Wheelie Pete that made her first appearance during the Shrouded Glade invasion where she had been acquired as a rare item drop. Currently she can be purchased from Cragara on rare occasions.

Pet Obtainment

220px|right
Harley is also a pet that can be obtained. This pet's skin have different colors.

Shrouded Gloam
Harley can be acquired through defeating the boss NPC located throughout Shrouded Glade during the invasion.

Cragara
Harley is available to everyone for purchase from Cragara, the Mysterious Merchant, at the price of  and to Members at the %10 discount price of .

TCG
220px|right

On March 21, 2013, a Trading Card Game creature card was introduced based on Harley in the Series 5 Rumbledome! Expansion. The card's ID is 5C45.

# Quests of Honeydew (Sunstone Valley)

## Honeydew (npc 9500000824, Sunstone Valley): unbuilt quests

None of the three quests is in `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json` (that folder has only adventurer, archer, blacksmith, brawler, card_duelist, chef, demo_derby_driver, fisherman, kart_driver, medic, miner, ninja, pet_trainer, postman, scavenger_hunt, soccer_star, warrior, wizard). The NPC file already lists all three with `quest_id: null` (`repo:…/npcs/sunstone_valley.json:10897-10946`). Warm Welcome (Peppermint's quest, which sends the player to Honeydew) is the lead-in and is not Honeydew's to build.

Build order: Helping Honeydew, then Meeting the Princess, then Distracting Druids. Only the first has a wiki page with text.

---

- **Title:** locale 413084 "Helping Honeydew". Title key ugdt 1500599317 (locale line 39774 in the test `en_us_data.dat`). The record and guide give the ucdt title key as 4087056571; I did not see that key in the locale output, so treat it as unverified.
- **Prerequisite:** Warm Welcome (wiki "previous: Warm Welcome"). Level and job: unknown.
- **Giver:** Honeydew (npc 9500000824; name string 413059). Location: near Skysong Ledge, north-west of Peppermint (locale 2697546481: "Meet Honeydew near Skysong Ledge, to the north west of Peppermint.").
- **Intro / offer:**
  - ucdt 1905476990 (detail summary): "The baby horses in Skysong Glade are running around all over the place! Honeydew has asked you to help her bring them back to the nursery as quickly as possible."

# Noggle Cogloose (npc 9500000838, name_string_id 440141), Sunstone Valley: unbuilt quest dossier

wiki.text:
Quetzalcoatl is a feathered drake NPC boss that can be found at the top of Drakewind Peak, located in Sunstone Valley.

To reach the top of the Drakewind Peak, it is required to complete the Noggle's Retreat quest line hosted by Noggle Cogloose.

TCG
220px|right

A Trading Card Game card was introduced based on Quetzalcoatl through the Series 5 Rumbledome! Expansion on March 21, 2013. The card's ID is 5R46.

Appearances
Free Realms Sunstone Valley -- Play Now!
Trading Card Game Series 5

Trivia
The name "Quetzalcoatl" is derived from a Mesoamerican deity, and translates to "Feathered Serpent" from the Nahuatl language.

wiki.text:
Not to be confused with Robgoblin Junk Thief or Robgoblin Mechanic.

Rizzle is a robgoblin NPC that can be found at Whirly's Scrap Camp, located in Sunstone Valley. He is known to be very lazy compared to other robgoblins by spending all of his time sitting around and drinking Sasparilla.

Biography
Rizzle and the other robgoblins had once been proud to be lazy, until robgoblins were cut off from Glimmerdeep to creating a junk supply shortage. Currently, with junk in short supply, most robgoblins are no longer sitting around, but Rizzle still tries. He now persuades players to do his work while he spends his time drinking Sasparilla.

Not to be confused with Sandscale Hunter.

Sandspear is a manguana NPC boss that can be found in Sunstone Valley. His attacks consist of using his spear and biting, as well as spitting a poison that slows the player's movement and damages over time. This can stack with the poisons of the manguana's around him. A group of two or more level twenty players is suggested when fighting him.

Drops from Chest

# Quests of Yarith Yewroot (Sunstone Valley)

# Yarith Yewroot (npc 9500000864): unbuilt quest dossier

Only one quest is given by this NPC in the record and wiki: **Sweets for Sniffles**. No file in `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/` mentions it (the quest folder holds per-job files; the only hits are the NPC record itself and `vendors.json`). So it is unbuilt and is the only candidate. The other Yarith-linked quests (Investigating the Cause, Gathering Evidence, Stopping the Spread, Flowers for Xeydia) are Princess Dreamdust's or Silverspark's givers in the guide, so they are out of scope here.

## 1. Sweets for Sniffles

**Title:** locale **413112** "Sweets for Sniffles". Hash key ucdt 2752052808 (guide row 77).

**Offer / intro:** locale **413113**: "Yarith has given you medicine that will cure the Unicorns of their allergies. You'll need to take it to Silverspark right away. Hopefully she likes it." (Wiki detail summary, `quest-pages.json:357`.) The offer line by Yarith is locale **413111**: "You say someone deliberately created these unnatural plants? That's terrible! ... Here, take this remedy to them. It should clear up that terrible sneezing problem they've been suffering from." (matches the wiki's step-1 quote).

# Blazing Star (npc 9500000874, legacy NPC id 3380, NameId 38027): unbuilt quests

**Record correction.** The record's `quests_given_text` says only "See Flax." Two other sources contradict that. The client text shows Blazing Star as the speaker of the missing-fish errands. The Lxzxrus community server gives Blazing Star (GiverGuid 100000003380) as the giver of two Pixie Nursery quests. Neither the wiki cache nor `quests/*.json` mentions these quests. wiki.title: Chase Wheeler
wiki.text:
Chase Wheeler is a human NPC that can be found in the Thunder Falls Speedway, located in Lakeshore. He stands next to the billboard on the west side of the gate entrance. Also his quests are part of the Kart Driver Quest Series, he will not offer you any quests until you have completed all previous quests in the series.

Quests
Kart Driver: Making Amends
Kart Driver: High Speed Chase
Kart Driver: Sweetwater Sasparilla Sponsorship

n9000000273.quest_dossier:
# Quests of Chase Wheeler (Wilds) # Chase Wheeler (npc 9000000273, Wilds, Thunder Falls Speedway): quest dossier **Scope.** Chase gives three quests, the Kart Driver series: Making Amends, High Speed Chase and Sweetwater Sasparilla Sponsorship. The record's `quest_ids_given` lists only 3080029. The other two are in `quests/kart_driver.json` as stubs (3080027, 3080028) with `objectives: []`, `rewards: []`, `enabled: false`, so I treat all three as unbuilt. Their giver is recorded as `9000000271` (see Gaps). The guide's parenthesised numbers are not locale ids (see Gaps), so every id below is a numeric locale id found by text search or taken from a stub. **Order (guide row, `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Kart Driver.md` rows 25–27, lines 90–92):** Settling the Score (3080026, title 3528) → Making Amends → High Speed Chase → Sweetwater Sasparilla Sponsorship → Thunder Falls Sprint Challenge (Shooblemoot, not built here). --- ## 1. Kart Driver: Making Amends (quest 3080027) - **Title:** 394702 "Kart Driver: Making Amends". Stub `kart_driver.json:1333–1386`, title_string_id 394702 (the stub's `title_string_id` is set, so this is evidenced). - **Giver:** Chase Wheeler, 9000000273 per the wiki list (`refs` wiki page "Chase Wheeler": "Kart Driver: Making Amends" listed). Stub giver is 9000000271 (conflict, see Gaps). - **Prerequisite:** Kart Driver: Settling the Score (3080026, title 3528; `kart_driver.json:1295`). Guide row 25 says "After Settling the Score". The wiki says Chase only gives quests once the earlier series quests are done. Level: unknown. - **Intro (offer), 394701:** "I figure if you were able to steal them from me, you should be able to steal my parts back from Linx.

You'll need to find where Linx has his kart stashed.

# Quests of Finneus Farstrider (Wilds)

# Finneus Farstrider (npc_id 9500000897, Wilds): quest dossier

Nothing for this NPC is in `quests/*.json`. A search for Finneus, 1714229715, 23747, 23762, 1074673927, 23007, 21252 and 20925 found no built quest. The record's "Titles not found" is now resolved for two quests below.

Locale note: the client's `ucdt`/`ugdt` hashes (e.g. 1714229715) are not usable as `locale` tool keys. The `locale` tool uses small sequential ids. I matched each hash to its id by identical text, because the client's `en_us_data.dat` holds the hash and text together. No `lab/reports/locale-id-map.json` is in the repo to confirm this.

---

## Quest 1: Return the Stolen Mail to Finneus Farstrider (built: no; live title, recommended first)

- **Title:** locale **23747** "Return the Stolen Mail to Finneus Farstrider". Hash `ucdt` 1714229715 (`repo:notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Wilds.md` row 94; `locale/en_us_data.dat:45260`). No "NOT LIVE" prefix.
- **Giver:** Finneus Farstrider, locale 20925, record npc_id 9500000897 (`repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/wilds.json:15566`).
- **Intro / offer:** locale **23749** "That Robgoblin camp out the back there has been causing all sorts of problems for us. Those critters will take anything that isn't nailed down when they sneak about here! Our local mailman Finneus Farstrider had all his mail snatched by the Robgoblins. Head over to their camp and pick up the pieces they've scattered on their way back from here." A variant with the same story but no "when they sneak about here" clause is 24988 (hash 4182897137).
- **Objective (journal):** locale **23748** "Finneus is in the Robgoblin Camp looking for the stolen mail. Once you've gathered it all, find Finneus and hand the mail over to him." Hash 5

n9500000936.quest_dossier:
# Quests of Roroo (Wilds) ## Summary Roroo (npc_id 9500000936, name_string_id 5118) is **not the giver** of the only quest tied to him. The evidence shows him as the **receiver** (the endpoint of a delivery). The quest is "NOT LIVE - Greenwood Care Package", so the client holds only its text, not a live quest definition. No other quest for Roroo is evidenced. The "Wilds: Roroo" tag is not a quest. Only one candidate exists, and it is the only one below. Note on ids: the record's ucdt/ugdt values are hash keys in the client's `en_us_data.dat`. The `locale` tool does not resolve them (for example 1933239181 returns "no such id"). I read those lines directly from `refs:opening-harvesting-native-20261009T142624Z/locale/en_us_data.dat`. The `locale` tool uses its own numeric ids (for example 24046 is the title text), which I cite separately. ## Quest 1: Greenwood Care Package (NOT LIVE) - **Built already?** No. `grep` of `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/` for "Care Package", "Roroo", "Greenwood Camp" and the title ids returned no quest file. - **Title:** "NOT LIVE - Greenwood Care Package". Ids: ucdt 1993718478 (`en_us_data.dat` line 52525) and ugdt 329287513 (line 8727). Locale tool id **24046** carries the same text. The title is the only one in the client; no non-"NOT LIVE" title exists. - **Offer / intro:** ucdt **1933239181** (dat line 50980), exact text: > "I have a task for you that you will need to handle... delicately. You see, the soldiers at the Greenwood Camp need some nourishing meals if they are to continue fighting off the Thugawugs.

The chef of the Greenwood Camp, Burnetta, tries her hardest, but she is not exactly a skilled chef. Take this care package to Roroo at the Greenwood Camp, and take care not to let Burnetta find out." - **Obj

n9500000937.quest_dossier:
# Quests of Sakka (Wilds)

## Sakka (Wilds, npc_id 9500000937): no unbuilt quests

Every quest the record and guides attribute to Sakka is already built in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/ninja.json`. I did not write a new dossier, because the rules skip built quests. The one real problem is that the built entries point at the wrong giver id (see below).

### Quests named for Sakka and their build status

| Quest (client title) | Title locale id | Built in ninja.json | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ninja: Idol Conversation | 78889 (ucdt 899397350 / ugdt 2790688077) | id 3110017 (array entry at ~line 1019), `enabled: false` (line 1068) | `NPCs - Wilds.md:78`; `Jobs/Ninja.md` row D4 (line 102) |
| Ninja: Achieve Level 15 | 387209 (ugdt; ucdt 2531704661) | id 3110018 (~line 1071) | `NPCs - Wilds.md:78`; `Jobs/Ninja.md` row D5 (line 103) |
| Ninja: Missive for Michi | 78928 (ugdt 316576290; ucdt 2084212531) | id 3110020 (~line 1171), prerequisite 3110018 | `NPCs - Wilds.md:78`; `Jobs/Ninja.md` row F2 (line 110); `NPCs - Snowhill.md:136` |

- Locale ids were checked with the `locale` tool for these titles.
- The intro, objective and end-text ids for these quests are already on the built entries, and I did not re-verify them.
- Snowhill's Sakka (9500000766) lists the same quests, so it adds nothing new.

### Other Sakka-linked quests (not given by Sakka)

- Band 4 rows F3 (Ninja: Real Ultimate Power), F4 (Ninja: The Masterless Ninja) and F5 (Ninja: Ice Troll Rampage) are given by **Michi**, not Sakka (`Jobs/Ninja.md:111-113`). They are built in ninja.json and are not Sakka quests.
- The Floren Forest fragment-return and "Return to Sakka" text belongs to D4 (`Jobs/Ninja.md:102`), so it is covered by the built Idol Conversation.

wiki.title: Sleeping Panther
wiki.text:
Sleeping Panther is a human NPC merchant that can be found near the Tavern Cellar, located in the Northern Wilds. She sells exclusively Ninja Job items.

Sells
Sekkou Ninja Shoulderguard
Sekkou Ninja Hakama
Sekkou Ninja Cowl
Sekkou Ninja Armwraps
Sekkou Ninja Boots
Sekkou Ninja Gi
Ninja's Power Shard of Regeneration II
Ninja's Ring of Energy II
Ninja's Necklace of Bark Skin II
Ninja's Blade of Shuriken Storm
Ninja's Blade of 1000 Storms

Trivia
Sleeping Panther was introduced in-game on August 27, 2013.

## Summary

Tido's record lists four quest titles, "Free Tido", "Free Sola", "Free Mifa" and "Free Dore". None is built in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json`. I found the titles and one line per captive in the client text. I found no offer text, objective lines, completion text, steps, prerequisites or rewards for any of them, and no evidence that Tido gives them. I did not write a per-quest dossier for each title, because every one would have the same gaps. The four are treated as one group below.

## Quest group: "Free Tido / Sola / Mifa / Dore" (not built; no build-ready content)

n9500000967.quest_dossier:
# Quests of Boranug (Wugachug)

# Boranug (npc 9500000967, Wugachug entrance): quest dossier

Boranug's record lists one quest, "Welcome to Wugachug!". The evidence actually supports a different first quest, **Join the Party**, which is the opening step of the Sasparilla Hunt chain. Nothing in the record or the guide's quest table is explicitly tied to Boranug except by wording. Two notes on the record:

- Its "Rival score in Kart Driver: Endorsement Deal (401856720)" line is not a quest he gives. Endorsement Deal is given by Shooblemoot and Twingnbor (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Wugachug.md`, row 45), and the locale line 401856720 does not resolve. Boranug is only the rival there.
- The "Talk to Boranug" lines (1770500935, 2285048403 in the record; locale 5101431 and 5101471 here) belong to the Chug-a-Mug Challenge block (locale 5101360 to 5101471). The guide gives that quest to Chugzy (`NPCs - Wugachug.md`, row 143), so they are not Boranug's own quest.

Quest-id note: the locale-tool numbers (e.g. 385979) are the ids the Lxzxrus server uses as TitleId/DescriptionId. The `en_us_data.dat` keys in the record (e.g. 1426312283, 1820519853) are different hash keys for the same strings. Both are cited below.

## 1. Join the Party (Sasparilla Hunt 1/7) — strongest evidence

- **Quest id (community reconstruction):** QuestId 3100, Lxzxrus `Quests.json:1102-1103`. Comment: "Sasparilla Hunt 1/7: Boranug at the Wugachug gate sends you to the Brewmaster."

wiki.title: Chugzy
wiki.text:
Chugo'Zytok'Rylary the Banished, short for Chugzy, is an elf NPC that can be found near the Wugachug warpstone during the Heroes Journal questline.

Dialogues

Trivia
Chugzy was introduced in the update of August 13, 2013.
Chugzy is currently the only known elf in Sacred Grove, although he wasn't the first introduced in-game because we seen a female elf in the Memorial Caverns Murals and a male elf named Elvis in the Free Realms Issue 3 which aren't introduced in-game until the only one elf was introduced.
However there are two elves; a female elf in the Memorial Caverns Murals and Elvis in the Free Realms Issue 3 we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Chugzy's kind.
Also a female elf from the Memorial Caverns Murals and Elvis from the Free Realms Issue 3 seem to has peach skin color, thus implying that there are different skin colors of the elf race.

# Quests of Cook Yumtumlot (Wugachug)

## Summary

Cook Yumtumlot (npc 9000000061, name string 41248) gives two Chef quests that are already built: **3050025 Chef: Surprise Me!** and **3050026 Chef: The Food Reviewer** (`prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/chef.json` ~L1326-1440; `npcs/wugachug.json` L2989-3118). Those are not repeated here. Chef: Chugawhat? (M6, id 3050024) is also built, but its giver is set to 9000000044 (Chef Jarvie), and the record says Jarvie sends the player to her, so it is not hers.

Only one unbuilt item has a usable title and objective text. It is weakly evidenced, so treat it as a candidate and not a confirmed quest.

## Candidate 1: "NOT LIVE - Run, Run As Quick As You Can" (ingredient run for Yumtumlot)

  2. 71661 "Return to Cook Yumtumlot in Wugachug"
  3. 71691 "Return the ingredients to Cook Yumtumlot." 71692 "Cook Yumtumlot is in her cooking tent in Wugachug."
